title: Amazon Marketplace Support Specialist
description:
Amazon Marketplace Support Specialist

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented Amazon Marketplace Support Specialist to manage and optimize our Amazon selling operations. This role is critical in maintaining accurate product listings, resolving marketplace issues, and ensuring seamless integration between our Shopify platform and Amazon marketplace presence.



Key Responsibilities:

Amazon Listing Management



Update Existing Amazon Listings: Maintain and optimize current product listings including titles, descriptions, images, pricing, inventory levels, and product specifications to improve visibility and conversion rates

Load New Amazon Listings: Create and publish new product listings on Amazon marketplace, ensuring compliance with Amazon's listing policies and category-specific requirements

Issue Resolution & Support



Dialog with Amazon Support: Communicate directly with Amazon Seller Support to resolve listing issues, account problems, policy violations, and marketplace disputes in a timely and professional manner

Platform Integration Management: Collaborate with Shopify marketplace manager to synchronize product data, inventory levels, and listing updates between Shopify and Amazon platforms

Additional Responsibilities



Monitor listing performance metrics and suggest optimization strategies

Ensure compliance with Amazon marketplace policies and guidelines

Track and report on listing status, sales performance, and marketplace issues

Maintain accurate records of all marketplace communications and resolutions

Stay updated on Amazon policy changes and marketplace best practices



Required Qualifications



2+ years of experience managing Amazon Seller Central or similar e-commerce marketplace platforms

Strong understanding of Amazon listing optimization and SEO principles

Experience with Shopify platform and marketplace integrations

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data management

Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time management skills



Preferred Qualifications

Amazon marketplace certifications or training

Experience with inventory management systems

Knowledge of Amazon advertising (PPC) campaigns

Familiarity with product photography and listing optimization tools

Experience in e-commerce customer service or marketplace support



Skills & Competencies

Problem-solving and analytical thinking

Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities

Customer service orientation

Technical aptitude for learning new software platforms

Understanding of e-commerce metrics and KPIs



Work Environment

This position may be performed remotely or in-office, with regular computer-based work and frequent communication with internal teams and external marketplace support representatives.

title: Amazon Marketplace Support Specialist
description:
Amazon Marketplace Support Specialist

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented Amazon Marketplace Support Specialist to manage and optimize our Amazon selling operations. This role is critical in maintaining accurate product listings, resolving marketplace issues, and ensuring seamless integration between our Shopify platform and Amazon marketplace presence.



Key Responsibilities:

Amazon Listing Management



Update Existing Amazon Listings: Maintain and optimize current product listings including titles, descriptions, images, pricing, inventory levels, and product specifications to improve visibility and conversion rates

Load New Amazon Listings: Create and publish new product listings on Amazon marketplace, ensuring compliance with Amazon's listing policies and category-specific requirements

Issue Resolution & Support



Dialog with Amazon Support: Communicate directly with Amazon Seller Support to resolve listing issues, account problems, policy violations, and marketplace disputes in a timely and professional manner

Platform Integration Management: Collaborate with Shopify marketplace manager to synchronize product data, inventory levels, and listing updates between Shopify and Amazon platforms

Additional Responsibilities



Monitor listing performance metrics and suggest optimization strategies

Ensure compliance with Amazon marketplace policies and guidelines

Track and report on listing status, sales performance, and marketplace issues

Maintain accurate records of all marketplace communications and resolutions

Stay updated on Amazon policy changes and marketplace best practices



Required Qualifications



2+ years of experience managing Amazon Seller Central or similar e-commerce marketplace platforms

Strong understanding of Amazon listing optimization and SEO principles

Experience with Shopify platform and marketplace integrations

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data management

Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time management skills



Preferred Qualifications

Amazon marketplace certifications or training

Experience with inventory management systems

Knowledge of Amazon advertising (PPC) campaigns

Familiarity with product photography and listing optimization tools

Experience in e-commerce customer service or marketplace support



Skills & Competencies

Problem-solving and analytical thinking

Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities

Customer service orientation

Technical aptitude for learning new software platforms

Understanding of e-commerce metrics and KPIs



Work Environment

This position may be performed remotely or in-office, with regular computer-based work and frequent communication with internal teams and external marketplace support representatives.

title: Remote Sales Representative / Client Coordinator (Fluent in English) - (US Hours) (MALE only)
description:
We are hiring 3 Client Advisors / Crisis Response Coordinators to join our remote team. We are currently prioritizing candidates for Shift B. All shift schedules are based on Manila Time / Philippine Time (PHT).



As part of your application, please send a 60-second English voice recording introducing yourself, explaining why you are a strong fit for this role, and briefly summarizing your phone-based sales, client support, or customer service experience.



* Important Requirement: This is a full-time, dedicated role. We are looking for candidates who can fully commit to this position during the assigned shift.



This role is not suitable as a second job, side job, or additional freelance role. Because response time, reliability, and emotional availability are critical in this position, candidates must not be working another job that conflicts with their schedule, focus, or performance.



* About the Role: This role includes a sales component, but it is not an aggressive sales role. You will not be pushing a product to random leads.



Your job is to respond quickly to inbound inquiries, calm the client when needed, understand the urgency of the case, explain how the service works, recommend the right service package, and guide the client through agreement, payment, onboarding, and handoff to our operations team.



We are looking for candidates with a mature, steady, and confident phone presence. The right person should sound calm under pressure, communicate clearly with US-based clients, and handle sensitive conversations professionally.



* What You’ll Do:

- Respond to inbound leads through phone, SMS, WhatsApp,
, and messaging platforms within minutes.

- Conduct first consultations by listening to the client’s situation, assessing urgency, and recommending the most suitable service package.

- Explain the services, pricing, onboarding steps, contracts, and expectations clearly.

- Guide clients through the agreement, payment, and onboarding process.

- Coordinate with the operations team after the client signs up to ensure a smooth case handoff.

- Follow up with clients at key milestones, including after 24 hours, weekly updates, and service completion.

- Maintain accurate records in our dashboard, including lead status, call notes, messages, contracts, and follow-up tasks.

- Collect client feedback and reviews after successful service completion.

- Work reliably during your assigned shift to ensure fast response coverage.



* What We’re Looking For:

- At least 2 years of phone-based sales, customer service, client consultation, call center, or account support experience.

- Clear spoken English and the ability to communicate confidently with US-based clients.

- Calm, mature, and professional phone manner.

- Strong empathy and emotional control when speaking with distressed clients.

- Ability to guide a conversation without sounding pushy or aggressive.

- Experience handling objections, pricing conversations, and follow-ups.

- Strong reliability. Late starts, missed shifts, and no-shows directly affect client response times.

- Ability to fully commit to this role as your primary work commitment.

- Fast and stable internet connection.

- Quiet workspace suitable for professional calls.

- Own computer, headset, and microphone.

- Comfortable using CRM, dashboard, messaging, and calling tools.



* Nice to Have:

- Experience in legal services, insurance, cybersecurity, financial services, healthcare support, emergency support, trust and safety, or crisis-related customer service.

- Previous experience working with US-based clients.

- Inbound sales, client advisory, retention, or customer success background.

- Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Notion, GoHighLevel, Slack, WhatsApp Business, Aircall, RingCentral, Zendesk, or similar platforms.

- Experience in sensitive client conversations where confidentiality, trust, and clear communication are important.



* Priority Shift Schedule:

- We are currently prioritizing candidates for Shift B (4:00 AM – 12:00 PM Manila Time / PHT). Candidates must be consistently available during the full assigned shift.



* Compensation & Growth:

- Base salary: $800/month

- Commission: 3%–10% on closed deals, depending on monthly performance and collected revenue.

- Additional performance incentives may include client review bonuses and other performance-based rewards.

- Top performers may be promoted to Senior Client Advisor / Team Lead, with a base salary increase and additional training responsibilities.



* Employee Benefits:

- Monthly base salary + tiered commission.

- $10 bonus per verified customer review.

- $300 retention bonus every 3 months of tenure.

- 13th month pay: 1× base salary, paid by December 20, soft-conditional on hitting average commission performance.

- 10 days paid annual leave per year.

- 3 days paid sick leave per year, no doctor’s note required.

- 2× pay if you work on Philippine regular public holidays.

- Full Sunday off, guaranteed weekly rest day.



* Hiring Process:

- Application review.

- Resume/CV and voice recording review.

- Written screening assessment.

- Live interview with scenario-based questions.

- Reference/profile check.

- Offer, NDA, agreement, and onboarding.



* How to Apply:

- Please submit your resume/CV and a 60-second English voice recording.



* In your recording, please include:

- A brief introduction of yourself.

- Why you believe you are a strong fit for this role.

- A short summary of your phone-based sales, customer service, call center, client consultation, or account support experience.

- Confirmation that you can fully commit to this role during Shift B and that this will not be treated as a second job.

title: Lead Engine Specialist
description:
Do you light up when you get someone on the phone?



If you're the person who would rather make 50 calls than send 50
s — who genuinely enjoys striking up a conversation with a stranger and finding out what's going on in their world — keep reading. This role was built for you.



Sure Home Buyers helps homeowners across Southwest Missouri sell their property quickly and without the hassle of a traditional listing. Behind every deal is one thing: a real conversation with a homeowner who needed a solution. You are the person who starts those conversations and keeps them going.



This is the cornerstone seat in our business. You generate the leads, build the relationships, nurture the maybes, and hand truly motivated sellers to our acquisitions team ready to talk. When you do this well, the whole business moves.



Who we are



We're a startup with one clear goal: to become the go-to home buyer in Southwest Missouri — not the biggest, the most trusted.



The people we help are usually in a tough spot. Facing foreclosure. Holding a property they never wanted or inherited. Tangled in a complex title problem they don't know how to solve. They don't need a sales pitch — they need a way out. Our job is to listen first, build a creative solution that actually fits their situation, and hand them back something they've been missing: peace of mind.



That shapes who we hire. We serve, we don't pressure. The right person for this seat genuinely cares about the person on the other end of the line — and then knows how to move the conversation forward. Hold both, and you'll fit right in. And because we're early, you're getting in on the ground floor of something we're building to last.



What you'll own



Reach out — warm and cold. Spend the majority of your day on the phone and texting. Cold outreach to fresh lists, warm follow-up with people who've already raised a hand, and fast response to inbound leads.

Follow the script, read the room. We give you proven scripts for each lead type. You'll know them cold and still sound like a human, not a robot.

Set the appointments. Your number-one outcome: book qualified appointments for our acquisitions team — multiple per week from genuinely motivated sellers.

Run a clean CRM. Pull and load lead lists, log every touch, take detailed notes, update statuses, and keep our pipeline organized and current. No lead falls through the cracks on your watch.

Enrich the data. Dig in and fill out every lead record — phone numbers, owner details, property info — so we know as much as possible about every person before we call.

Nurture the funnel. Stay on top of follow-up so warm leads don't go cold and every motivated seller keeps moving toward a conversation with acquisitions.

What a good week looks like



You've worked your lists hard, had real conversations with dozens of homeowners, your CRM is spotless, and you've set several solid appointments with sellers who actually want to talk. Acquisitions opens their calendar and the next steps are obvious. You go into the weekend knowing exactly what you produced — and so do we.



Who you are



You love talking to people. This is non-negotiable. The phone energizes you; it doesn't drain you.

You're relentlessly organized. Notes, follow-ups, and CRM hygiene are second nature.

You're goal-oriented. You like a target and you like hitting it. You measure your day in conversations and appointments.

You're coachable and self-directed. You'll follow our scripts and systems, and you'll run your day without someone standing over you.

Bonus, not required: experience in real estate, sales, appointment setting, telemarketing, customer service, or any phone-heavy role.

Compensation



This is a performance-based 1099 contract built to reward activity and results:



Paid per qualified contact you make

Paid per appointment you set

Bonus on every deal that closes — uncapped

The harder and smarter you work the phone, the more you earn. If you're driven and consistent, this rewards you for it.



The details



Schedule: Part-time, flexible hours within standard calling windows

Classification: 1099 independent contractor

Location: Fully remote. We're prioritizing candidates local to Southwest Missouri, but strong candidates anywhere will be considered.

The work: Phone and text the majority of the time. You'll need a reliable computer, a quiet space, and solid internet.

How to apply — read this carefully



Because this role is all about how you connect with people, your application starts with your voice.



Send two things to 



A 60-second-or-less video of yourself. Tell us who you are and why you'd be great at talking to homeowners all day. Don't overthink it — a phone selfie video is perfect. We want to see your energy.

Your resume.

That's it. Applications without a video won't be reviewed — the video is the first step. We're excited to meet you.

title: B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter for US Legal Tech Startup (Part-Time Evening Shift, $5-6/hr + Bonuses)
description:
ABOUT US



A.I. Esquire builds AI software for solo and small law firms in the United States. Our flagship product is KAY, a 24/7 AI receptionist that answers the calls a law firm would otherwise miss, runs intake, and books the consultation before the caller dials the next firm on Google. Flat $197 a month.



The founder is a US trial attorney who spent 15 years in law and built the product he wished his firms had. He also built the sales motion. He makes 30 cold calls a day into law firms himself. You will work his scripts, his lists, and his calendar. You will never be handed an untested pitch and told to figure it out.



THE ROLE



Simple to describe, hard to do well: get US law firm owners on the phone and book them into a 15-minute demo where they hear KAY answer a live call. The demo is our best closer. Your number is held demos, meaning demos where the attorney actually shows up.



You will:





Make outbound cold calls to solo and small firm owners in personal injury, family law, criminal defense, immigration, and estate planning. Lists are provided and enriched. No scraping your own leads.

Work a proven call framework with practice-area openers and objection handling. Leave live voi
s. Log every dial.

Book qualified demos directly onto the founder's calendar and send a short confirmation
 (template provided).

Report what you hear: objections that keep coming up, patterns in who picks up, bad numbers on the list. Your notes shape the playbook.





You will not run demos or close deals. The founder does that. Your job is to fill his calendar with the right people.



WHO YOU WILL BE CALLING



American attorneys. Busy, skeptical, and very good at saying no. They screen through gatekeepers and most have been burned by a legal tech pitch before. If that sounds miserable, do not apply. If it sounds like a challenge, here is the good news: attorneys know exactly what a missed call costs them. One missed personal injury call can be a $50,000 case that hired the next firm that answered. You are pointing at money on the floor. So I know you actually read this far: the first word of your application must be GAVEL.



SCHEDULE





Monday to Friday, 8:00 PM to 12:00 midnight Philippine time (8:00 AM to 12:00 noon US Eastern). 20 hours per week.

This is a fixed evening shift, not graveyard. Your first 90 minutes each day are our prime calling window.

If this goes well, hours grow. Our first great setter becomes the anchor of the sales team as we scale.





TARGETS





40+ dials per shift

Ramp to 3+ held demos per week by week three

Weekly numbers review with call recordings and direct feedback from the founder, the person who wrote the script





COMPENSATION





$5 to $6 USD per hour base, depending on experience

$25 USD bonus per held demo (the attorney shows up)

$150 USD bonus per demo that becomes a paying customer

At target, this role pays roughly $800 to $1,200+ USD per month for 20 hours a week

Paid weekly during your first month via Wise, EasyPay, or PayPal (your preference), then every two weeks

The first week is a paid working trial. We may run trials with more than one candidate before making the final hire.





REQUIREMENTS





2+ years of outbound cold calling or appointment setting for US or other Western clients. BPO or freelance both fine. B2B experience is a strong plus.

Excellent spoken English. Clear and confident on the phone. You will be talking to lawyers.

Quiet workspace, good headset, and stable internet with a backup plan (secondary connection, mobile data, or nearby co-working space). Power backup is a plus.

You can follow a call framework without sounding like you are reading one.

CRM discipline. We use HubSpot. If it is not logged, it did not happen.





HOW TO APPLY





Start your application with the required first word. It is hidden somewhere in this post.

Include a voice recording link (vocaroo.com is fine), 60 to 90 seconds total, doing two things. First, read this opener out loud as if a busy attorney just picked up: "Hi, this is [your name]. I know I'm calling out of the blue, so I'll be quick. When someone calls your office about a new case and nobody picks up, where does that call go?" Second, tell me about the hardest audience you have ever cold called and how you got past their gatekeepers.

In 2 to 3 sentences, describe your outbound calling experience with US clients.

Confirm you can work the 8:00 PM to 12:00 midnight PHT shift, Monday to Friday.





Applications without the correct first word and a voice recording will not be reviewed.

title: HR Specialist/ (Full-Time, Remote – Philippines)
description:
Company Overview

DrayEasy Inc is a steadily developing international enterprise. We are seeking a versatile HR Specialist based in the Philippines to independently conduct full-cycle human resource operations. This role emphasizes employee relations management, requiring candidates to be adaptable and detail-oriented in a fast-paced working environment. Fluent in Chinese is a strong plus.



Job Summary

The HR Specialist will be in charge of end-to-end recruitment, personnel transfer & separation, performance management, one-on-one employee counseling, staff care, and training arrangements. The ideal candidate must be independent, empathetic, proficient in employee communication, and familiar with employee risk management. You need to be process-driven, meticulous, and capable of adapting to a fast-paced remote working environment. Candidates with Chinese language proficiency will be given priority consideration.



Key Responsibilities

1. Full-cycle Recruitment: Publish job openings, screen resumes, conduct interviews, coordinate hiring processes, and complete talent matching according to department staffing demands.

2. Employee Lifecycle Management: Manage employee onboarding, job transfer, status adjustment, resignation and termination procedures; organize and file employee documents to ensure complete and standardized personnel files.

3. Performance Management: Assist in optimizing performance appraisal systems, organize regular performance evaluations, sort assessment data, follow up on performance feedback, and complete data statistics.

4. Employee Relations: Maintain daily communication with employees, respond to HR-related inquiries, properly handle daily employee relation issues, and build a positive team atmosphere.

5. Training & Employee Care: Organize employee onboarding training and deliver HR policy training; arrange one-on-one employee interviews and emotional counseling, track staff dynamics, and improve employee retention rate.



Qualifications & Requirements

1. Minimum 2 years of solid HR working experience, familiar with recruitment, employee lifecycle management, and performance management processes.

2. Proficient in employee relations management, skilled in one-on-one counseling, emotional guidance, staff care and training.

3. Strong data sorting ability, rigorous and detail-oriented in daily work.

4. Excellent interpersonal and coordination skills to communicate with all-level employees.

5. Self-motivated and responsible, capable of independently handling full-cycle HR tasks.

6. Proficient in Office software, able to make training materials and maintain employee relation records.

7. Must have backup internet such as prepaid WiFi/data for stable remote working.

8. Must have a power backup in case of power outages.

9. Shift arrangement: Day shift for the first month, then transfer to night shift permanently.

10. Ability to speak and understand Chinese is a bonus qualification.



Application Guidelines

If you are interested in this position, please submit the following materials:

1. Your updated resume (resume link is acceptable).

2. Interested candidates please submit your application and fill out the questionnaire via the link below:

ue2fl6z2dmj.sg.larksuite.com/share/base/form/shrlgzDguRc5jayVxeQLRnvW8Vc



Notice: Please mention in your application message that you have completed the questionnaire. We will conduct preliminary screening by combining your questionnaire information and resume. Candidates who pass the initial screening will be contacted via email for an interview invitation. Wish you all the best.

Company Benefits

We provide a stable working environment and clear career growth. Your professionalism and dedication will be highly valued. Candidates with Chinese skills enjoy better development opportunities and priority in recruitment. We are looking forward to your application!

title: QA Analyst : ERP & Business Systems URGENT
description:
We're looking for someone who knows accounting and will be a key voice in the direction of the software we create.



At Hutility, we build and support ERP customizations, integrations, automation, and custom software for organizations running on Sage 300 and similar platforms. We're looking for someone who's experienced in the accounting workflows we're building for: someone who can look at what the software does and know whether it makes sense for a real business.



What you'll be doing

·	Review and validate ERP features, fixes, and enhancements by asking whether they make sense from an accounting perspective

·	Follow transactions end-to-end across workflows like AP, AR, GL, procurement, billing, payroll, and inventory, and flag when something doesn't behave the way a real business would expect

·	Work directly with developers and consultants to explain what the expected business outcome should be

·	Document issues clearly: what happened, what should have happened, and why it matters

·	Help the team understand the real-world impact of a bug or design decision on accounting accuracy, reporting, and day-to-day operations

·	Apply structured QA practices over time: test planning, regression testing, defect tracking, etc.



You'll be a great fit if you...

·	Have hands-on experience in an accounting role: AP, AR, GL, payroll, inventory, procurement, or similar

·	Have used an ERP or accounting system in a real work environment (Sage, SAP, QuickBooks, NetSuite, Dynamics, Acumatica, or even Excel-heavy environments)

·	Can walk a developer through what "correct" looks like for a transaction, a report, or a reconciliation

·	Notice when numbers, postings, or workflows don't add up. Even when no error message fires

·	Are curious about how software works and genuinely interested in learning the technical side

·	Pick things up quickly and enjoy figuring things out on your own

·	Communicate clearly: you can make complicated situations easy to understand



What success looks like

·	Developers get clear, actionable feedback grounded in how accounting actually works

·	Issues are caught before they cause incorrect postings, broken reconciliations, or problems that impact the business downstream

·	The team builds more confidence that what they're shipping reflects real-world accounting logic, not just technical correctness

·	You grow into owning the QA process over time, with the accounting knowledge as your foundation

·	This role can branch into many career possibilities such as ERP consulting, software development, management, etc., depending on your skills and interests.

title: Short-Form Video Editor & Social Media Scheduler (Full time)
description:
Short-Form Video Editor & Social Media Scheduler (Full time)



**Salary:** $650 USD/month

**Hours:** 38 hours/week, flexible — you choose your schedule

**Type:** Long-term, work from home

**Start:** As soon as we find the right person



About the work



We manage the personal brand of a UK chartered surveyor based in Dubai. He has 35 years in property and runs a YouTube channel about life and business in the UAE, alongside property consultancy, a property academy, and media work.



There is already a library of long-form video footage. Your job is to turn it into short clips, and to keep five social accounts posting consistently.



This is not a strategy role and it is not a "grow my following" role. It is a craft role. We need someone who is genuinely good at finding the interesting 40 seconds inside a 30-minute video, and who is reliable about getting things published on schedule.



---



What you'll do



- Cut short-form clips (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) from existing long-form footage — roughly 12–15 finished clips per week

- Add captions, hooks, and light on-screen text

- Schedule and upload across five platforms:
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn

- Maintain a simple posting calendar so we always know what's going out and when

- Write short captions and hashtags to a supplied brief and tone guide

- Send a brief weekly report: what was posted, what performed



You will not be d
 brand direction or writing long-form posts. We brief you weekly; you execute.



What we need from you



**Required:**

- Real experience cutting short-form vertical video — TikTok, Reels, or Shorts. Show us.

- Fluent with at least one of: CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve

- Comfortable posting natively on all five platforms, including scheduling tools

- Written English strong enough to caption for a professional British audience. This matters more than usual — the audience is property investors and business owners, and clumsy copy costs credibility.

- Reliable internet and a machine that can handle video editing

- Available for at least 2 hours of overlap with Dubai time (GST) on weekdays



**Nice to have:**

- Basic graphic design (Canva is fine)

- Any exposure to property, finance, or professional-services content

- Experience with a personal brand rather than a company account



What we're honest about



The footage is not always exciting. Some of it is a man talking to a camera. Your value is finding the 
nt that isn't boring and building a clip around it. If you need dramatic source material to make good clips, this role will frustrate you.



We are also picky about tone. Ian is a chartered surveyor with three decades of credibility. Clips must never look cheap, over-edited, or like generic hustle content. No zoom-punch-on-every-word, no stock 
 audio.



How to apply



Please do not send a generic application. We read every one and we can always tell.



Send us:



1. **Links to 3 short-form clips you personally edited.** Tell us which platform each was for, and what the source footage was.

2. Start your message with the word **BLUEPRINT** so we know you read this far.



We respond to every applicant who follows the instructions above.

description:
Position Overview:



As the Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of the executive office. Your primary responsibility will be to provide comprehensive administrative support to the CEO, managing their schedule, and coordinating various tasks to enhance productivity. Your ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and proactively handle administrative duties will contribute to the overall effectiveness of the CEO's office.





Pay Range: $8 per hour with a performance review scheduled after 90 days of employment. We believe in rewarding exceptional talents.





About Power Plus Systems:



Power Plus Systems LLC has been a dominant force in the residential electrical contracting industry for two decades, and we continue to lead the way. Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. /internationalcareers

title: Funnel & Landing Page Specialist
description:
Funnel & Landing Page Specialist — Localization & Google Ads (Shopify / WordPress)

Location: 100% Remote (Philippines)

Company: Petformed / Refoamed

Full-time | Contract | Mid

$800 – $1,100 USD/month + performance bonus



ABOUT US



We run e-commerce brands in the pet and health space and sell across 12+ European markets. The team is under 10 people, fully remote, and moves fast. We grow 2–3x year over year, and in 2026 we're launching 20+ new brands. We're AI-first — Claude and ChatGPT are part of every process. We're not a corporate: no 15 layers of approvals, decisions same day.



We already have proven products, proven funnels, and people who d
 the strategy. What we're missing is a production machine for funnels — someone who takes a winning funnel and reliably clones it across countries, builds new landing pages from our templates, and spins up keyword-matched pages for Google Ads, at volume, without breaking anything.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We're looking for a Funnel & Landing Page Specialist who is a PRODUCTION EXECUTOR. Most of your time is spent taking funnels that already work and adapting them to new countries — swapping language, currency, offers, shipping and legal, publishing to new URLs, and keeping the tracking intact. The rest is building new landing pages from our templates and producing landing-page variants matched to Google Ads keywords/ad groups.



You don't invent the strategy — the angles, offers and "why it converts" come from the CEO and strategist. You don't manage the ad budgets — bidding and campaign spend stay with our media buyer. You deliver speed, volume and accuracy. You get a brief and an SOP; how you deliver is up to you.



You report to the CMO and work closely with whoever runs our Google Ads.



WHAT YOU GET FROM US ON DAY 1





Proven, winning funnels and landing-page templates to clone — you don't start from zero

An established stack (Shopify + page builder, WordPress/Elementor) and SOPs for cloning + localization

Proven products in 12+ countries — assets, copy, social proof

All AI tools paid for (Claude, ChatGPT, and localization/design tools)

Clear briefs from the CMO and the Google Ads owner — and direct contact with them and the CEO





WHAT YOU'LL DO



Localizing & cloning existing funnels across countries (~65%)





Clone our winning funnels and adapt them for new markets: language, currency, pricing, offers, shipping, legal/footer

Publish to new country domains / subdomains / URLs with a clean, consistent URL structure

Keep all tracking intact through the clone: GTM, GA4, Google Ads conversions, Meta Pixel, correct UTMs

Do the localization drafts with AI; our team proofs the Polish





Building new landing pages & funnels (~20%)





Build new landing pages and funnels from our templates and briefs, in Shopify (Replo/PageFly/GemPages) or WordPress/Elementor

Keep layout, speed and mobile clean; nothing broken, nothing slow





Google Ads landing pages & message match (~15%)





Produce landing-page variants matched to keyword themes / ad groups so the page mirrors the search intent (message match, Quality Score)

Wire up conversion tracking and UTMs correctly; support A/B tests

Generate volume of URLs/variants without errors





Light QA & maintenance (ongoing)





Check links, tracking, page speed; maintain a clean version/asset library





MUST HAVE





Proven experience building AND cloning landing pages / funnels — with a portfolio of LIVE URLs. We want links, not screenshots. Hard filter.

Both stacks: Shopify (+ a page builder like Replo/PageFly/GemPages) AND WordPress/Elementor. You've shipped real pages in both.

Google Ads understanding for landing pages — you get campaign/ad-group structure, message match and Quality Score, and why the landing page must mirror the keyword and ad.

Tracking hygiene — this is critical. GTM, GA4, Google Ads conversion tracking, Meta Pixel, UTMs. You do NOT break tracking when you clone a page. Someone who breaks pixels is worse than no hire.

Speed and volume — you think in templates, variants and SOPs, not one hand-polished page.

Basic URL / domain / subdomain logic and clean on-page basics (title, H1, meta).

Good English (C1) — you work in English; you localize into other languages with AI (our team proofs the Polish). Polish is NOT required.

Active AI use. In your application, give ONE concrete example of how AI let you deliver faster/better.

Self-sufficient — you follow an SOP precisely, ask questions upfront, and deliver without hand-holding.

Reliable internet + workspace and at least 4h daily overlap with Central European Time (CET).





NICE TO HAVE





Direct-response marketing knowledge / having built funnels that actually sold — you understand why comparison pages convert and why CTAs repeat down the page (a strong plus, not required)

Hands-on Google Ads (running/optimizing campaigns, not just building landing pages)

CRO / A/B testing tools (VWO, Convert, etc.)

Programmatic / bulk page generation, feed- or template-driven pages

Basic HTML/CSS for quick fixes

Multi-market EU experience; e-commerce / DTC, pet / health / supplements

ClickFunnels / GoHighLevel or similar funnel builders





WHAT WE OFFER





$800 – $1,100 USD/month, depending on experience

Performance bonus tied to output and results

100% remote, flexible hours (output > presence); 4–5h CET overlap

Direct work with the CMO, the Google Ads owner and the CEO — no layers

All AI tools paid for

A growth path as we launch 20+ brands: more funnels, more markets, eventually leading a small production team

Stable, long-term collaboration





RECRUITMENT PROCESS





Online test (20 min) — general aptitude test + personality test

Portfolio — we'll ask you to send your portfolio of live landing pages/funnels (Shopify + WordPress) + one concrete AI-use example

Interview with CMO

Trial period





If this sounds like you — apply.

title: Chat Intake Training Manager
description:
About Juvo Leads

Juvo Leads is one of the fastest-growing live chat and legal intake companies in the United States. For more than 11 years, we have helped law firms connect with prospective clients through live chat, inbound call handling, appointment scheduling, and intake services.



Our primary focus is serving law firms nationwide, helping them create exceptional first impressions and convert more qualified prospects into clients.



While much of the industry continues to move toward automation, AI, and chatbots, our philosophy remains simple:

Butts in Seats. Not Bots in the Cloud.



We believe that when someone is searching for legal help, they deserve to interact with a real person. Every conversation we handle is powered by a trained human tea
mber—not artificial intelligence. Our commitment to genuine human interaction is what sets us apart and has fueled our growth for more than a decade.



As we continue to expand, we're building a world-class remote workforce capable of delivering exceptional service at scale. We are looking for leaders who are passionate about developing people, improving performance, and creating systems that help employees succeed.



If you're excited about building high-performing remote teams, developing talent, and creating measurable business impact through training and coaching, we'd love to meet you.



Overview

We are seeking a Training Manager to own the onboarding, development, certification, and ongoing education of our remote chat agent workforce. This role is responsible for ensuring every new hire receives a consistent, high-quality training experience and is fully prepared to succeed in production.



The Training Manager will design and deliver training programs, oversee agent readiness, partner with Operations and Quality teams to address performance gaps, and continuously improve learning initiatives that drive quality, efficiency, and client outcomes. This position is accountable not only for training delivery, but for the measurable success of agents after training.



The ideal candidate has experience building and managing remote training programs, coaching adult learners, developing curriculum, and creating scalable processes that support rapid organizational growth.



 Key Responsibilities: 



New Hire Training & Onboarding

  * Own the end-to-end onboarding and training experience for all new chat agents.

  * Design and deliver structured onboarding programs that prepare agents for legal intake and live chat responsibilities.

  * Ensure all new hires complete training, certification, and graduation requirements within established timelines.

  * Conduct readiness assessments and certify agents before transition to production teams.

  * Facilitate seamless handoffs between Training, Operations, and Quality teams.



Training Program Development

  * Design, implement, and continuously improve training programs for new and existing agents.

  * Develop lesson plans, training materials, SOPs, assessments, simulations, certifications, and knowledge base content.

  * Ensure training content remains current, accurate, and aligned with operational processes and client requirements.

  * Create scalable training systems capable of supporting company growth and new client launches.

  * Incorporate adult learning principles and instructional design best practices into all training initiatives.



Coaching & Employee Development

  * Deliver engaging virtual training sessions using a variety of learning methods and technologies.

  * Provide coaching, mentorship, and developmental feedback to employees throughout their tenure.

  * Partner with supervisors to identify employee skill gaps and create targeted development plans.

  * Build refresher training, continuing education, and performance improvement programs.

  * Support career growth initiatives, internal promotions, and leadership development pathways.



Performance Assessment & Quality Improvement

  * Develop evaluation tools to measure trainee comprehension, readiness, and performance.

  * Track post-training performance to evaluate training effectiveness.

  * Analyze quality trends, recurring errors, and operational performance metrics to identify training opportunities.

  * Collaborate with Quality Assurance and Operations teams to reduce performance gaps and improve outcomes.

  * Ensure retraining initiatives are deployed quickly when performance concerns emerge. 



Collaboration & Program Management

  * Partner closely with Operations Leadership, Quality Assurance, and Client Services teams.

  * Support new client launches, process updates, script changes, and system enhancements through training initiatives.

  * Maintain accurate reporting on training completion, certifications, graduation rates, retention, and performance outcomes.

  * Establish best practices for knowledge transfer, coaching, documentation, and employee development.

  * Build and manage scalable training processes as the company continues to grow.



 Qualifications 



  Required 

  * Bachelor's degree in Education, Training & Development, Communications, Psychology, Business, Human Resources, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.

  * Minimum 3 years of experience designing, delivering, and managing training programs in a fully remote environment with 50-100 employees. 

  * Proven experience onboarding, coaching, developing, and upskilling remote employees with teams of 50-100. 

  * Experience creating and maintaining virtual training curricula, certification programs, assessments, knowledge bases, SOPs, and continuing education programs.

  * Experience using remote training and knowledge management platforms such as Trainual, NotebookLM, Loom, Google Workspace, LMS platforms, testing tools, and virtual meeting software.

  * Experience in Live chat, Customer Service, Legal Intake, Contact Center Operations, Sales, Appointment Setting, or other performance-driven environments in the U.S. market. 

  * Strong understanding of adult learning principles, instructional design methodologies, coaching techniques, and performance management.

  * Demonstrated ability to provide performance coaching, career development guidance, and individualized improvement plans.

  * Experience partnering with Quality Assurance and Operations teams to identify skill gaps and implement training solutions.

  * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

  * Strong organizational, project management, and time management skills.

  * Ability to simplify complex concepts into engaging, actionable, and measurable learning experiences.

  * Data-driven mindset with experience using performance metrics, quality scores, and operational KPIs to evaluate training effectiveness.

  * Experience working with cross-functional, multinational teams supporting U.S.-based clients. 



 Preferred

?Managing multiple client accounts independently with consistent performance, maintaining strong client retention, and demonstrating full cross-platform capability (Meta + Google/YouTube) so Jumper can confidently scale its client base.

We're a boutique artist management company looking for an organised, proactive finance professional to support the financial administration of the artists we manage.

Instead, we're looking for someone who can become the day-to-day financial contact for our artists—keeping their bookkeeping up to date, managing invoicing, ensuring records are complete, calculating management commissions, and making sure everyone stays on track with their financial obligations.

Ensure invoices are accurate and sent promptly.

Track outstanding invoices and payment due dates.

Follow up professionally on overdue invoices.

You'll:



Ensure receipts and invoices are collected and stored correctly.

Follow up with artists when documentation is missing.

Prepare documentation so our accountants always have what they need.

Calculate management commissions in accordance with each artist's management agreement.

Prepare commission summaries and supporting calculations.

Raise management commission invoices where required.

Maintain accurate commission records.

Accountant & Compliance Coordination



Working alongside our external accountants, you'll help ensure everything is completed on time.



This includes:



Preparing bookkeeping for BAS and tax return preparation.

Liaising with our accountants regarding information requests.

Tracking BAS, tax and other compliance deadlines.

Following up with artists for outstanding documentation.

Maintaining a recurring calendar of financial obligations so nothing is missed.

About You



We're looking for someone who:



Has strong bookkeeping experience using Xero.

Has experience preparing or assisting with BAS.

Has a solid understanding of Australian GST and bookkeeping requirements.

Is confident working with Australian businesses and tax processes.

Has excellent organisational skills and strong attention to detail.

Is comfortable communicating directly with clients and accountants.

Is proactive and confident following up on outstanding information.

Can manage multiple artists and priorities simultaneously.

Takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.

Has C2 (Advanced/Mastery) English proficiency with excellent written and verbal communication skills.



Experience working with musicians, creatives, agencies or talent management businesses would be highly regarded but isn't essential.



What Success Looks Like

Every artist's bookkeeping is current and reconciled.

Invoices are issued promptly and outstanding payments are actively managed.

Receipts and financial records are organised throughout the year.

Management commissions are calculated accurately and on time.

BAS preparation is smooth because accountants have everything they need.

Artists know exactly what information they need to provide and when.

To Apply

Why you think you'd be a great fit for this role.

title: Creative Operations Manager - E-commerce
description:
Want to run a creative department end to end? Join us as Creative Operations Manager: full ownership of the team, the dashboard, and the output of a fast-growing e-commerce brand.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce company hiring a Creative Operations Manager to run our creative department: video editors, graphic designers, and copywriters.



You are not here to make the creative. You are here to make the creative machine run. Capacity, output, deadlines, and people.



This is a leadership role. You are trusted to own outcomes, not be micromanaged on tasks.

If you prefer a task-only execution role, this is not for you.



This role lives in the numbers. You'll own our creative dashboard entirely, and at any 
nt you'll know who has room for more work, who's overloaded, and what's at risk of slipping, before anyone asks.



You don't manage from a distance. You catch problems early, confront underperformance head-on, and make tough people decisions with confidence.



Full ownership is the goal. This role is measured by one thing: how efficiently you scale creative output without sacrificing quality.





What You’ll Own:



The Dashboard and Capacity Planning

- Own the creative ops dashboard: capacity, utilization, deadlines, and workload.

- Track output per editor and per project. Spot bottlenecks before they hit.

- Forecast production and hiring needs weekly and monthly.

- Bring leadership data-backed recommendations, not opinions.

- When a number drops, you find the leak and have a fix in place.



The Team

- Directly manage the video editing team, with copywriters in scope when needed.

- Run interviews and assess talent well. Hiring is core to this role.

- Run one-on-ones and performance reviews.

- Hold people accountable. When someone underperforms, name the problem, set a clear path with a deadline, and if they don't hit it, make the call yourself.



Process, Systems, and AI

- Audit and rebuild outdated workflows and SOPs across the creative pipeline.

- Every project has an owner, a deadline, and a status. You enforce all three.

- Use AI daily to multiply output: SOPs, data analysis, automation, reports, forecasting.

- Grow capacity without growing headcount.

- Strong with spreadsheets and automation tools.

- Keep individual contributors, managers, and leadership in sync so production never stops.





Must-Haves:

- 3+ years in operations or team management, ideally overseeing creative or production teams.

- Highly analytical and obsessed with numbers. Capacity planning, utilization, and performance metrics are your comfort zone.

- Direct communicator who doesn’t avoid conflict. You address problems head-on and don’t let issues sit.

- Comfortable making difficult people decisions, including terminations, and experienced in doing so.

- Proven experience running structured interviews and hiring.

- Data fluent. Strong in spreadsheets, and you know when to use a median over an average.

- Technical enough to work with automation tools, scripts, and developers, and to pick up new software fast.

- Heavy, hands-on use of AI in daily ops work. You can name what you use and why.

- Extremely organized and process-oriented. Nothing sits, nothing waits, and you always know who’s stuck and on what.

- Strong written and spoken English. You’ll run meetings, hold people accountable, and write SOPs.

- Daily overlap from 1 PM to 10 PM Manila time (GMT+8), and reachable when urgent issues come up.



Nice-to-Haves:

- Experience managing video editors, designers, or other creative production teams at scale.

- Experience building or owning a capacity or KPI dashboard.

- Strong experience inside ClickUp, Notion, Airtable, 
, or similar.

- Experience building AI workflows or automations.

- Basic understanding of video production workflows. You don’t need to edit, you need to know what “done” and “good” look like.



How we hire is fast and respectful of your time

1. Fill out our quick form. Simple questions, ~5 minutes.

2. We reply to every single person who applies. No ghosting.

3. Pass the first round ? a short interview to ensure culture fit

4. Past the first interview ? a short technical interview.

4. Crush it ? we send you an offer.



What you get when you go full-time (after a 1 to 2 month probation):

We genuinely take care of our team.

- Salary raise above your starting pay

- 13th-month pay

- 18 days paid time off + holidays

- Every AI tool you need, paid by us

- Health insurance

- Annual training/learning budget

- A chance to fly out and meet the rest of the team (totally optional)





We invest hard in our people. We're looking for someone who wants to build something long-term.



Apply now. It takes 5 minutes.

title: Video Editor & Motion Designer (Paid Social) - Muscle Nation
description:
We’re looking for a mid-level Video Editor & Motion Designer to join Muscle Nation’s creative team and help produce high-performing paid social content. This role is equal parts editing and motion design where you’ll cut raw footage into conversion-focused video ads AND build polished motion assets including supers, lower thirds, animated transitions, and kinetic typography.



If you understand how paid media ads are structured, know what makes someone stop scrolling in the first 3 seconds, and can execute both live-action edits and motion graphics at a high level - we want to hear from you!



About the Role



You’ll work across
, Instagram, and TikTok ad campaigns, collaborating closely with our Creative Strategist, Paid Media Manager, and videographers. You’re not just assembling clips - you’re building ads with a clear understanding of direct-response structure: hook, body, CTA. You know how to re-hook viewers throughout a piece using pacing shifts, visual pattern interrupts and motion elements that maintain attention.



Your Day-to-Day



- Edit video content for paid social campaigns across Meta and TikTok, working with existing footage and assets stored in Google Drive

- Create 3+ variations per concept for testing - different hooks, pacing, CTAs and visual treatments to maximise performance

- Design and build motion assets: animated supers, lower thirds, text overlays, transitions, kinetic typography, and branded end cards

- Craft scroll-stopping hooks in the first 1–3 seconds using a combination of editing technique and motion design

- Apply re-hook techniques throughout each ad - pacing changes, visual pattern interrupts, text callouts, and motion cues that sustain viewer attention

- Adapt content across platform-specific formats and aspect ratios (9:16 Stories/Reels, 4:5 Feed, 1:1 where needed)

- Collaborate with the Creative Strategist and Paid Media Manager to interpret briefs, understand performance data, and iterate on creative direction

- Coordinate with videographers to understand available footage and plan asset requirements

- Test new creative approaches and editing styles while maintaining brand consistency

- Manage multiple projects simultaneously with quick turnaround times

- Stay current with paid social trends, platform algorithm changes, and emerging ad formats



What We’re Looking For



- 2-4 years of video editing experience with a focus on social media advertising or performance creative

- Strong motion graphics and animation skills - you can build supers, lower thirds, animated text, transitions, and branded elements from scratch in After Effects (or equivalent)

- Proficiency in video editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar) plus experience with After Effects or a comparable motion design tool

- Experience with AI-driven editing and design platforms

- Deep understanding of paid ad structure - you know how hooks, body content, and CTAs work together to drive conversions

- Strong design eye - you understand typography, layout, colour, and hierarchy, and can apply these principles to motion assets that look polished and on-brand

- Knowledge of platform-specific video formats, specs, and best practices across Meta and TikTok

- Experience creating multiple creative variations for testing and optimisation

- Ability to work with feedback efficiently, managing multiple projects with tight deadlines

- Excellent communication skills for collaborating with creative and paid media teams across time zones



Bonus Points



- Experience with fitness, wellness, or supplement brands

- Understanding of paid social advertising metrics (CTR, hook rate, hold rate, thumbstop ratio, ROAS)

- Experience editing UGC-style content for direct-response campaigns

- Familiarity with creative testing frameworks and iteration processes

- Background working with e-commerce brands or performance marketing agencies

- Familiarity with the Australian market and cultural nuances



Work Arrangement



- 30-day contract with a view to transition into a full-time role based on performance and mutual fit

- Based in the Philippines, working remotely with our Australian team

- Flexible schedule with regular meetings alongside AU creative and paid media teams

- Reporting to the Creative Strategist and Paid Media Manager



How to Apply



Please note: we will only progress applications that complete the task below.



Video Editing & Motion Design Task



Objective:



Promote our Protein Water to fitness enthusiasts aged 22–35 through engaging short-form paid social content.



Brief:



You’ve been provided with raw footage here. Your task is to create 3x short-form video ads (15–30 seconds each), each with a different hook and creative approach, suitable for
 and Instagram Feed/Stories.



You can use placeholder footage or describe your editing approach where needed.



Available Assets:

UGC-style fitness creator footage (gym setting, protein shaker)

Pouring clips

Workout clips

Product pack shots

Backdrop footage



What We Want to See:



- A strong, scroll-stopping hook within the first 3 seconds of each variation - show us you understand what makes someone stop and watch

- Re-hook techniques throughout each ad that sustain viewer attention (pacing shifts, visual pattern interrupts, text callouts, motion cues)

- Motion design elements you’ve built: supers, lower thirds, animated text, transitions, or branded end cards - these should demonstrate your design ability, not just your editing chops

- Understanding of paid ad structure: hook > body > CTA

- Platform-appropriate formatting in both 9:16 and 4:5 aspect ratios



Submission Requirements:

- 3x video ad variations as described above

- Your portfolio showcasing relevant paid social video and motion design work

- A brief cover letter explaining your experience with performance creative and motion design, and why this role excites you



Evaluation Criteria:



- Hook effectiveness - does it stop the scroll in the first 3 seconds?

- Re-hook and pacing techniques - how well do you sustain attention throughout the ad?

- Motion design quality - are your supers, text treatments, and transitions polished and well-designed?

- Understanding of paid ad structure and platform best practices

- Creative storytelling and performance marketing mindset

- Technical editing skills and attention to detail



We’re excited to see how you can help elevate our paid social creative and drive results for Muscle Nation!

mber, built from a master template/snapshot so new sub-accounts can be spun up quickly and consistently.

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, run a proven script, and book them onto the salon's calendar.



If you're a sales-oriented setter who loves high-volume work, runs scripts the way they were written, and is motivated by performance pay tied to real results — keep reading. If you want a low-pressure customer service job or you like "making the script your own," this won't be a fit.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script word-for-word for the entire call, from greeting to booking. The only time you go off-script is to answer a client's specific question (directions, timing) or collect unique info.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We say "word-for-word" because that's how the role works — but we want to clear up the most common concern people have about that:



"Won't I sound like a robot if I'm reading a script?"



No. Think about the best actors in your favorite movies. They're saying lines someone else wrote. They don't sound robotic because they've rehearsed enough that the words feel natural, and they bring real warmth, tone, and presence to the delivery. THAT'S EXACTLY WHAT WE'RE AFTER. The script is the structure. Your tone, pacing, and warmth are what make it feel human.



We train for this. You'll rehearse, get coached on tonality and pacing, and review your own call recordings until the words feel like yours — even though they're not. The setters who do this best sound like they're having a natural conversation that just happens to follow a proven path.



The script DOES change over time — but only based on data. If something isn't landing in calls, we test a new version, measure the results, and update the script if it works better. What we don't do is let setters freelance individual changes on the fly, because then we can't tell what's working and what's not.



If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll genuinely consider it. We'll A/B test it together. If the data shows it works better, it becomes the newscript. That's the structured way changes happen here.



If that framing works for you, you'll thrive. If "follow a script and let us measure what works" feels suffocating, this role won't be a fit.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



- Advanced English with minimal accent. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- Strong spoken communication — clear voice, confident on calls, doesn't ramble, not soft-spoken.

- Script discipline. You're comfortable running proven scripts word-for-word in mandatory parts of the call. (See the script section above for context on what this actually means day-to-day.)

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Process-oriented. You follow standardized workflows. If you want to change something, you bring a clear, data-backed suggestion to your manager and wait for a decision.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 25 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between July 13 – July 20

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: | 
 |



IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:



- A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar)

- A short Loom video introducing yourself

- A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net)

- A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor)

- A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages

- A few short questions to gauge fit



Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.



---



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Ethan

Founder, Midnight Siren



---
