title: Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
Position Overview:



As the Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of the executive office. Your primary responsibility will be to provide comprehensive administrative support to the CEO, managing their schedule, and coordinating various tasks to enhance productivity. Your ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and proactively handle administrative duties will contribute to the overall effectiveness of the CEO's office.





Pay Range: $8 per hour with a performance review scheduled after 90 days of employment. We believe in rewarding exceptional talents.





About Power Plus Systems:



Power Plus Systems LLC has been a dominant force in the residential electrical contracting industry for two decades, and we continue to lead the way. Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. At Power Plus Systems, LLC, a position with us isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to grow and develop within a company that genuinely appreciates your contributions and dedication to our shared mission.





Objectives:

• Manage and organize the CEO's daily schedule, including meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements.

• Act as a gatekeeper, screening and prioritizing communications to the CEO.

• Coordinate and facilitate communication between the CEO and internal/external stakeholders.

• Anticipate the CEO's needs and proactively handle tasks to ensure optimal time management.

• Coordinate special projects and initiatives as assigned by the CEO.





Competencies:

• Exceptional organizational and multitasking skills, with keen attention to detail.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion in handling sensitive information.

• Proficient in using Microsoft Office and Google Suites.

• Familiarity with scheduling software; experience with additional productivity tools is an advantage.

• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with individuals at all levels.

• Proactive problem solver and resourceful thinker.





Equipment Requirements:

• Must own a reliable computer or laptop capable of handling administrative tasks efficiently.

• Must own and actively use an iPhone and/or MacBook or Mac computer for efficient communication and task management.

• High-speed internet connection to support video calls, cloud-based collaboration, and remote work.





Physical Requirements:

• Extended periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.



Benefits:

• Growth opportunities in a well-established company.

• Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.

• Opportunity for advancement within the company.

• A supportive and collaborative work environment.

• Company-observed paid United States holidays (full time).

• Paid vacation.





How to Apply:



If you are ready to join Power Plus Systems, LLC, a well-established residential electrical contractor that values its tea
mbers and offers excellent benefits, please submit your application through the link below.




/internationalcareers



Power Plus Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds to apply.



Join us at Power Plus Systems, LLC, and be part of our continued success as we embark on the next 20 years of excellence in residential electrical contracting!

title: Short Form Editor
description:
About Blue Zone:

We’re Blue Zone — a rebellious pet nutrition brand from the Netherlands on a mission to give dogs their longest, healthiest lives. We do this with our air-dried, raw-quality dog food that’s as honest as it gets. No marketing fluff. No filler. Just real food, built on truth and transparency.



Now, we’re looking for a *skilled and motivated video editor* to help bring our message to life across digital channels. You’ll be crafting high-converting, emotionally compelling ad creatives that tell our story in a way people actually want to watch.



Your Mission (if you choose to accept it):

You’ll be turning raw content, user-generated videos, brand video’s, and brand messaging into attention demanding content. Think short-form edits, voiceover-led explainer reels — and a whole lot of creativity in between.



We're not your average pet brand. So we don’t want average creatives. We’re growing fast, and we’re here to shake things up.



What We’re Looking For:

- Strong Editing Skills

        You’re a master at Premiere Pro & After Effects and know how to turn raw footage into compelling short-form content. High-quality transitions, pacing, and storytelling are your jam.

- Quick to Learn, Quick to Adapt

     We move fast, so you need to be comfortable with quick feedback loops, tools, and our systems.

    

- Reliable and Communicative

        We don’t micromanage — but we do expect clear communication and fast delivery. If something’s unclear or blocking you, you speak up early.

    

- Eager to Improve

        You’re open to feedback, love to grow, and aren’t precious about revisions. We’ll support your growth with editing guides and brand templates.

    



Must-Haves

- Fluent in English (written + spoken)

- 2+ year of video editing experience

- Tools you already use; After Effects & Premiere Pro

- Solid sense of visual design: spacing, color, contrast, hierarchy

- Comfortable using AI tools

- Minimum availability: 20 hours/week (40h preferred)



What You’ll Get

- A long-term, remote role with a fast-growing brand

- A creative-first team where your input matters & you can make an actual impact

- Freedom to grow your role and responsibilities

- Access to ready-made assets, AI tools, and a clear process

- A company mission worth standing behind (and a few very cute dog photos)



Compensation

- approx. $800/month full-time

- Growth opportunities as we scale



How to Apply

1. Complete the form & trial task linked below:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfeyjzydXLlXp8sieHSxEdVSIhCeb1WH6dnJohUN1FvzDkaBg/viewform?usp=header

    

2. Send your edit along with your portfolio or relevant work

3. Include the word “ Bulalo” in your message, so we know you’re paying attention



We can’t wait to meet you,



Dean



CEO, Blue Zone

https://bluezonepets.com

title: AI-Assisted Cartoon Video Creator for Children’s Dog Safety Animation
description:
I am looking for someone to create a short AI-assisted animated cartoon video for children that teaches them how to safely interact with dogs.



This video will be part of a dog bite prevention course. The goal is to make the video simple, kid-friendly, warm, clear, and educational.



The final video should be approximately 2.5–3 minutes long.



You may use AI animation tools, templates, stock assets, Canva, CapCut, Animaker, Vyond, Runway, Pika, or similar tools. I am not looking for custom frame-by-frame animation. I am looking for someone who can take a script and turn it into a clean, engaging educational video for kids.



Budget



$150 fixed project



This includes:



3-minute finished animated video

AI-assisted or template-based cartoon animation

Basic characters: child, parent, dog, dog owner

Simple backgrounds

On-screen text

Music and simple sound effects

1080p final video

2 revision round



Important:



The dog should not look scary. The goal is not to make kids afraid of dogs. The goal is to teach children how to respect dogs, give them space, and interact safely.



The video should teach kids:



Ask an adult before approaching a dog

Ask the dog’s owner

Let the dog come to you

Pet gently under the chin, chest, or shoulder

Never hug, kiss, grab, chase, climb on, or pull a dog

Leave dogs alone when eating, sleeping, chewing, hiding, in a crate, or with puppies

Give dogs space when they look uncomfortable

Test Clip Required



Before hiring for the full project, I would like a short 10–15 second paid test clip.



Test clip scene:



A child sees a dog and starts to walk toward it. The parent gently stops the child and says, “First, we ask before we say hi.” The child then stands calmly while the dog has space.



Paid test clip: $25



If the test clip is a good fit, we will continue with the full $150 project.



To Apply



Please reply with:



Samples of cartoon or AI-assisted videos you’ve created

What tools you use

How long it would take you to complete a 3-minute video

Whether you can add music, sound effects, and text

Confirmation that you understand this is a $150 fixed project

title: Subject: AI Engineer (Claude Code) - On-Site, Davao City
description:
THE ROLE IN 30 SECONDS

======================

We build real AI products for the Australian market - construction estimating, property inspection, marketing automation - and we build them the modern way: agentic development. We don't hand-code line by line. We architect systems and orchestrate AI coding agents (Claude Code) to ship production software fast.



We're hiring an AI Engineer who lives in that workflow: someone who builds entire platforms by directing AI agents, and who owns the CI/CD and cloud ops to ship and run them. You take a product end-to-end - architect it, build it agentically, deploy it, keep it live.



On-site in Davao. Full-time. If you ship 3x through AI leverage and know your way around CI/CD, Docker and AWS - keep reading.



WHO WE ARE

==========

Loopsmiths is an AI venture studio in Davao building software for Australian customers. We ship products people actually pay for - not staff-aug or body-shop work. Claude Code and agentic development are how a small team moves this fast - it's core to how we work, not a gimmick.



- Australian CEO, Davao-based CTO.

- Based in Davao City, with our development team on-site here too.

- Full-time core role, funded studio, on-time monthly pay. A long-term seat you grow with.



HOW WE BUILD (read this - it IS the job)

========================================

We build with agentic development. You architect the system, spec the work, and orchestrate AI coding agents (Claude Code) to write, test and refactor it - then you review, harden and ship. The skill isn't typing code; it's directing AI to produce production-grade software, and having the judgment to know when it's right and when it's wrong.



If you already build this way, you'll thrive here. If you still hand-code everything manually, this isn't the role.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

===============

- One product end-to-end: architect it, build it agentically, ship it, run it. First mission: get QuoteSmith launch-ready.

- CI/CD: pipelines, automated testing, safe fast deploys.

- Cloud ops: AWS / cloud infrastructure, Docker, VPS, environments, secrets, monitoring - you own how it runs in production.

- Reliability: no lead or trial ever silently lost - webhook retries, first-party capture, fallbacks.

- Reusable agentic + infra patterns, documented, so the next product spins up fast.



MUST-HAVE

=========

- Agentic development mastery: you build production software by orchestrating AI coding agents (Claude Code or equivalent), not hand-coding line by line. Show us what you've shipped this way.

- Strong architecture + system-design judgment - you can direct the agents because you know what good looks like and can spot when the AI is wrong.

- CI/CD: pipelines, automated testing, safe deploys.

- Cloud ops / DevOps: AWS (or strong cloud equivalent), Docker, deployment, environments, secrets, monitoring/alerting.

- Full-stack fluency across our stack: Next.js / React / TypeScript, FastAPI / Python, PostgreSQL / Supabase.

- LLM integration in production: Claude API, structured output, cost/latency control.

- Ships fast and reviews rigorously - high output through AI leverage, high standards on what actually merges.

- Strong written English + documentation discipline - our Australian side has to trust your updates.

- Based in / able to commute daily to Davao City for on-site work. Non-negotiable.



NICE-TO-HAVE

============

Claude Vision / multi-stage AI pipelines · Terraform / infrastructure-as-code · async queues (Celery or BullMQ/Redis) · Stripe billing · self-hosted n8n · React Native / Expo · security hardening (UFW/fail2ban/secrets) · prior tech-lead experience.



OUR STACK

=========

Next.js / React / TypeScript · FastAPI / Python · PostgreSQL / Supabase · Docker + AWS / cloud VPS + Vercel + Cloudflare R2 · Claude API + Claude Vision · Claude Code (agentic development) · CI/CD.



Products you'll touch: QuoteSmith (AI estimating for AU builders - your first focus), TCR (property inspection: web + React Native app + Claude Vision), Infinite Fly (n8n + AI marketing OS).



WHY THIS IS WORTH IT

====================

- Real ownership - you own a product from architecture to production, and make the calls.

- Work at the frontier of how software is actually built now: agentic development, not legacy manual coding.

- Lead-track: owning a product in a scaling multi-product studio is a fast path to Tech Lead / architect. Your scope grows as you prove out.

- Frontier AI products: Claude API, Claude Vision, LLM pipelines, automation - not legacy CRUD.

- Stability: funded studio, on-time monthly pay, on-site in Davao.



ON-SITE IN DAVAO - WHY IT'S A FEATURE

=====================================

Full-time on-site in Davao City. Not remote.

- Build world-class AI products for an international market without leaving Davao or going remote-isolated.

- Shoulder-to-shoulder with the CTO on the hardest problems - direct mentorship and same-day decisions no remote gig gives you.

- One serious role in your home city instead of juggling freelance clients across timezones.



HOW TO APPLY (this is the filter - read it)

===========================================

We read every application that follows these steps and ignore the ones that don't.



1. Subject line - use exactly this: "I build agentically - LOOPSMITH-DAVAO" (this is how we know you actually read the whole post; applications without it are skipped)

2. In one line, confirm you're based in / can commute daily to Davao City and are seeking a full-time on-site role.

3. Tell us how you build with agentic development: which AI coding tools you use, and one platform you shipped this way - what did you architect vs what did the agents do?

4. In 3-4 sentences: how would you keep an AI (Claude Vision) pipeline both reliable AND cheap at scale?

5. Link one system you built. Describe the single hardest technical/architecture decision you made on it, and why.

6. Share your portfolio - GitHub, live projects, or anything that shows what you've shipped.



Applications that reference our actual stack and how we build get read first. Generic copy-paste gets skipped.



If you build with AI and want to own real products - apply. We'd like to meet you.

• Consistency: children learn best with the same tutor at the same time each week, so we need you to hold a stable weekly schedule. We cannot accommodate ongoing recurring unavailability, such as monthly tournaments. Planned time off is fully supported — up to 40 working days per year, with at least two weeks' notice

title: Outbound B2B Appointment Setter – Cold Calling Australian Businesses (Remote, Part-Time)
description:
THIS IS A PHONE-BASED OUTBOUND SALES ROLE. Most of your hours will be spent making live cold calls to Australian businesses. If you are looking for admin, inbox or data-entry VA work, this is not the role for you.



ABOUT US

Talent Mining & Minerals (TMM) is a Western Australian labour hire company. We supply site-ready workers to mining villages, camp service providers, civil contractors and remote operations across WA: cleaners, kitchen hands, chefs, housekeepers, utility workers, site support staff and FIFO/remote site roles.



THE ROLE

You will not be recruiting candidates. Your job is to get decision makers on the phone, introduce TMM, qualify whether they use backup or overflow labour hire, and book meetings for the owner. The pitch is low-pressure: we are not trying to replace anyone's current suppliers. We position TMM as the reliable backup option when a client needs workers at short notice. These conversations are friendlier than a hard sell, but you still need to get past gatekeepers, handle knock-backs and keep dialling.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Make outbound cold calls to Australian businesses: mining village operators, camp service providers, facilities management, civil contractors and remote site operations

- Get past gatekeepers and reach the right decision maker: operations managers, procurement, HR, village managers, workforce coordinators and business owners

- Introduce TMM and position us as a backup / overflow labour option, not a replacement for their current suppliers

- Qualify prospects: do they use labour hire, who supplies them now, where do the gaps appear, who d

- Book qualified meetings directly into the owner's calendar

- Keep clean call notes and update the call sheet or CRM after every call

- Follow up persistently. Most meetings are booked on the second or third touch

- Report weekly on dials, conversations, decision makers reached and meetings booked



REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

- Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral, professional accent that Australian businesses will easily understand on the phone

- Proven B2B cold calling or outbound phone sales experience. This is not an entry-level or admin role

- Comfortable calling Australian (or UK/US/NZ) businesses and speaking with senior people

- Resilient with rejection. You can take 20 knock-backs and make the next call sound like the first

- Confident, natural phone manner. You sound like a person, not a script

- Sales mindset: you measure yourself on meetings booked, not hours logged

- Active LinkedIn profile (include the link in your application)

- Quiet workspace, reliable internet, quality headset and a backup plan for power and internet outages

- Available to work Western Australia business hours (AWST, UTC+8 – the same time zone as the Philippines, so no night shift)



NICE TO HAVE

Experience selling or setting appointments in recruitment, labour hire, staffing, construction, mining, industrial services, outsourcing/BPO, SaaS, finance, insurance or other B2B services. CRM and dialler experience valued.



PAY AND HOURS

- Part-time to start: 15 to 25 hours per week, with room to grow as results come in

- Western Australia business hours (same as Manila time)

- AUD $10 to $18 per hour depending on experience



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that skip any of these steps will not be considered. This is the first test of whether you follow a process.

1. A short cover note (max 150 words): who you have cold called before, what you were selling, and your best result

2. Your LinkedIn profile link

3. A 60-second voice recording (instructions below). Applications without a recording will not be reviewed

4. Your written answer to the call opener scenario below

5. Your available hours and your expected hourly rate in AUD



VOICE RECORDING (60 SECONDS, REQUIRED)

Go to 
 and record yourself as if you are live on a call, then paste the share link in your application. The scenario: you have just been put through to the Operations Manager of a mining village services company in Western Australia. Introduce yourself as calling from Talent Mining & Minerals, explain in plain language that TMM provides backup and overflow labour (cleaners, kitchen hands, chefs, housekeepers and site support staff at short notice), and ask one good qualifying question about how they currently handle staffing gaps. Speak naturally. Do not read word-for-word off a script. We want to hear how you actually sound on the phone.



CALL OPENER SCENARIO (ANSWER IN WRITING)

You call a camp services company. The receptionist answers: "He's busy. What's this about?" Write, word for word, what you would say next (3 to 5 sentences max). Your goal: get put through, or come away with the decision maker's name and the best time to call back.



PAID TRIAL

Shortlisted candidates get a paid 2-hour live calling trial at the agreed hourly rate. We provide a short brief on TMM, a one-page pitch outline and 15 to 20 real Australian prospects. We assess how you open, how you handle gatekeepers, how you respond to "not interested", and whether you identify or reach the right decision maker. Booking a meeting during the trial is a bonus, not a requirement.

Summary

Freelance - Progressive exclusivity - European market experience required



We are a fast-growing French brand. Our entire acquisition runs on Meta Ads. We need an experienced performance-driven video editor. Scripts are in French with an English translation provided. You translate, understand the emotional intent, and edit accordingly. All communication with the team is in English.



  What you will produce



Meta Ads 9:16 and 4:5 formats

UGC, talking head, testimonial, product in context -- same performance standard

10 to 20 creatives per month at cruising speed -- volume increases during launch phases



Variations and creative tests

Multiple versions of the same creative changing only the hook -- visually, textually, rhythmically

Goal: find the winner without starting from scratch every time



Finalized ready-to-run deliverables

Clean subtitles, solid audio mix, correct export formats -- what you deliver goes live without touch-ups



AI voiceovers integrated into the edit

Some creatives run without a human voice -- you generate, select and integrate the AI voiceover per brief

The result must sound natural and fit perfectly into the edit rhythm



  What we expect from you



Skills that make an excellent Ads editor

Instinctively identify the shot that scroll-stops in the first 3 seconds

Pick and extract the best footage from raw clips fast without hesitation

Edit fast without losing quality -- production pace is sustained

Bring energy: cuts, pacing, transitions, music, sound effects

Hold attention throughout -- no dead zones where the viewer disengages

Convey precise emotion through footage choices -- amplify a script, not just illustrate it

Integrate revisions quickly and cleanly -- one revision cycle, not three

Maintain consistent quality even under high volume



Working from French scripts

Scripts are provided in French with an English translation

You read the emotional intent behind each line and choose footage that amplifies it

Working from a translated script with full emotional accuracy is the core skill we test



Raw footage sourcing and organization

From raw footage, identify, select and classify the best shots before editing

Build your timeline from your selection -- not the other way around



AI voiceover

Proficiency with at least one AI voiceover tool (ElevenLabs, Murf or equivalent)

Select the right voice, adjust pacing, integrate cleanly into the audio mix



Organization and deadline respect

We work in real-time -- a creative delivered in the morning can go live in the afternoon

Anticipate blockers and flag a delay before it happens -- never after

A missed deadline without warning is a lost test iteration



Communication with the creative team

All communication is in English -- briefs arrive in French with English translation

Ask the right questions when a brief is unclear before editing -- not after

Iteration speed depends as much on your communication as on your editing



  What we offer



Stable compensation + performance bonus on creative results

Regular guaranteed volume -- no one-shot missions

Structured feedback after each creative -- you know what performs and why

Evolution toward full long-term exclusivity for the right profile

Increased responsibilities if the collaboration is solid



Before applying -- If you do not have e-commerce ad examples that actually ran, do not apply. We need someone who already masters the format and wants to build something long-term.

title: Meta Paid Ads Short-form Performance Video Editor
description:
This is not a polish-and-export job. Your job is to take a folder of raw footage — UGC, product shots, lifestyle clips — and turn it into a short-form ad that stops the scroll, holds attention, and makes someone want to buy.

We're a DTC leather goods brand running ads on
 and Instagram. We test a lot of creative, so you'll be cutting short-form vertical ads from briefs, often making several versions of the same concept to see what converts.



What we're looking for:



- A track record of high-performing Meta ads. You've edited short-form ads that have actually run on
/Instagram and driven results — not just videos that looked good, but videos that performed. Be ready to show us.



- Editing that tells a story and hooks the viewer. You know how to grab attention in the first 1–2 seconds and hold it all the way through, using pacing, structure, and cuts to keep someone watching instead of scrolling past.



- Showcasing the product. By the end of the ad, the viewer clearly understands what the product is, why it's worth having, and why they want it — the edit sells without feeling like a hard sell.



- The ability to work with any footage. Give you a messy, wide-ranging folder of raw clips and you can shape it into a clean, successful ad. Turning chaos into a story that converts is the core of this role.



- Know the editing requirements needed to produce engaging ads AND that display well on social media, think formats, clean captions (not spammy), good audio etc



What matters most: storytelling and performance, not technical polish. We'd take a rough cut that converts over a beautiful one that falls flat. Captions, sound design, and clean transitions matter, but they come after the story works.

You'll work from briefs and iterate quickly on feedback, so being responsive and organised is as important as your editing.



Requirements: proven short-for
ta ad editing (please link examples — not vlogs, weddings, or corporate videos), comfortable with fast iteration, and able to work hours overlapping our South African timezone. Daily AI-tool use in your workflow is a plus.



How to Apply:

Fill out the Google Form with your details AND complete the free trial task so we can access your abilities to edit videos that can hook and tell a story while selling the product.

title: Amazon Account Manager / Operations Manager
description:

-Optimize product listings for maximum visibility and conversions

-Manage all branding, positioning, and messaging efforts

-Implement CRO strategies and run continuous A/B tests

-Coordinate freelancers (designers, photographers, content creators)

-Monitor and improve brand health metrics: rankings, reviews, CTR, CR, etc.



Daily & Weekly Tasks

-Research product trends and discover new product ideas

-Analyze competitors for differentiation and CRO opportunities

-Track performance: sessions, conversion rates, sales rank

-Collaborate with supply chain, PPC, and creative teams to align launch and inventory strategies

-Build a consistent and strategic brand identity across all customer touchpoints

-Establish a repeatable, scalable system for product launches

-Increase customer loyalty and retention through compelling branding and messaging

KPI 1: Product Development Pipeline

Objective: Develop and maintain a validated pipeline of launch-ready products

Metrics: 

-Number of product ideas researched and validated monthly

-Number of products launched per quarter

-First 90-day sales & review performance

-Run research & validation using Helium 10 and market analysis

-Coordinate with suppliers, creatives, and PPC

-Maintain and update Product Pipeline Tracker



KPI 2: Conversion Rate Optimization

Objective: Improve listing performance through CRO strategies

Metric: Conversion Rate (%) from Amazon Business Reports

Actions:

-Optimize listings, copy, and A+ content

-Improve visuals and run split tests

-Monitor and iterate based on data and performance feedback

Required:

-3+ years of experience managing private label brands on Amazon

-Proven success with multiple product launches

-Deep understanding of Amazon SEO and the Amazon algorithm

-Expertise in Helium 10, keyword research, and listing optimization

-Skilled in briefing and coordinating designers and content teams

-Familiarity with A+ content, storefront management, and conversion tracking



Preferred:

-Background in marketing, branding, or e-commerce growth strategy

-Knowledge of CRO tools and testing platforms (e.g., ManageByStats, Splitly)

-Experience using tools like Asana, Notion, or Trello for project management

-Awareness of PPC’s influence on organic ranking

-High attention to detail and ownership mentality

-Strong marketing sense and customer-centric thinking

-Excellent written and verbal English communication

-Organized, self-driven, and proactive

-Analytical mindset – able to turn data into decisions



 What We Offer

-Competitive rates

-Fully remote, flexible working hours

-Bi-weekly payments and performance reviews

-Long-term role with growth potential

-Paid leave and additional benefits after 6 months (SSS, Pag-ibig, health insurance)

-Supportive team culture with room for innovation and contribution

-Training resources and personal development opportunities

1. Include in subject line: “[Your Favorite Book] - Amazon Brand Manager Application”

2. Attach your updated resume

3. Include a short video (2–3 min) introducing yourself and describing your:

-Experience with Amazon product research

-Tools you’ve used and how you used them

-One product you’ve helped launch and what made it successful

4. Complete the internet speed test from speedtest.net and attach a screenshot

5. Attach a screenshot with your computer specs.



Why Join Us?

This is more than just a brand management job. It’s an opportunity to lead, build, and scale something meaningful. If you’re driven by impact, autonomy, and a clear path to success, we’d love to meet you.

title: Dialler/Client Intake Specialist (Warm Leads Only) - Australian Claims
description:
We're growing and are looking for an outstanding Client Intake Specialist to become an important part of our team.



If you're confident speaking with people, enjoy helping others, are highly organised and want a role where your work genuinely makes a difference, we'd love to hear from you.



This is NOT a cold-calling role.



Every person you speak with has already contacted us or requested information about our services. Your job is to build rapport, understand their circumstances and guide them through the first step of becoming a client.



About Us

We are a growing Australian legal practice that helps people who can no longer work because of injury or illness access insurance benefits through their superannuation.

Many of our clients are going through one of the most difficult periods of their lives. Every conversation matters, which is why we're looking for someone who is professional, empathetic and genuinely enjoys helping people.

We believe in building long-term relationships with our tea
mbers by providing ongoing support, training and opportunities for growth.



What You'll Be Doing



Every day you'll be:

- Calling warm enquiries who have already requested information.

- Speaking with Australian clients over the phone.

- Building trust and making clients feel comfortable.

- Asking questions to understand their circumstances.

- Explaining our process clearly and professionally.

- Recording accurate notes in our CRM.

- Scheduling and completing follow-up calls.

- Sending client intake documentation when required.

- Working closely with our legal and administration teams.

- Submitting a daily end-of-day report.



Who Will Succeed In This Role?



You'll do well if you are someone who:

- Enjoys speaking with people.

- Communicates confidently in fluent English.

- Can build rapport quickly.

- Listens carefully before responding.

- Is organised and detail-oriented.

- Follows systems and processes consistently.

- Learns new software quickly.

- Takes ownership of your work.

- Can work independently while remaining part of a team.



Experience We Value



Experience in any of these areas is an advantage:

- Customer Service

- Client Support

- Appointment Setting

- Warm Lead Calling

- Virtual Assistance

- Insurance

- Medical Administration

- Legal Administration

- Australian Campaigns

- CRM Software

- Sales Support



If you don't have experience in every area but you're a fast learner with an excellent attitude, we'd still encourage you to apply.



Minimum Requirements



You will need:

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- A reliable computer.

- High-speed internet.

- A quiet, professional workspace.

- Availability to work Monday to Friday during Sydney, Australia business hours.

- The ability to learn new systems and follow established processes.



We want this to be a long-term role, not just another job.



What you'll receive:

- Full-time remote employment.

- Warm leads only—no cold calling.

- Structured training and ongoing coaching.

- A supportive Australian team.

- Weekly payments via Wise.

- Paid Christmas shutdown leave (pro rata).

- Opportunities for career growth as our business expands.

- Meaningful work helping Australians during difficult times.



Success in this role is measured by:

- Professional communication.

- Quality conversations.

- Accurate CRM notes.

- Consistent follow-up.

- Reliability.

- Organisation.

- Attention to detail.

- Teamwork.



To show you've read this advertisement, the first line of your application must say: Warm Leads Dialler



How to Apply



Please submit:

1. Your latest resume.

2. A short cover letter telling us why you're the right person for this role.

3. A Loom video answering the following question:



Imagine you're calling someone who has already enquired about making an insurance claim. They sound nervous and aren't sure whether they want to continue.



How would you introduce yourself and help them feel comfortable speaking with you?



Please answer naturally, as though you're speaking directly to a real client. We are not looking for a memorised script—we want to hear your communication style, confidence, empathy and ability to build rapport.



We look forward to meeting you!

title: EXPERIENCED VIRTUAL MEDICAL OFFICE ASSISTANT
description:
Gravity Psychiatry & Wellness, PLLC is a growing outpatient psychiatric practice based in Illinois, USA. We provide psychiatric medication management, Spravato® treatment, and related services to children, adolescents, and adults through in-person and telehealth appointments.



The practice is independently owned and led by a board-certified psychiatric-mental health nurse practitioner. This is our first dedicated administrative hire and is intended to be a stable, long-term position.



POSITION SUMMARY



We are seeking an experienced Virtual Medical Office Assistant to manage the core front-office operations of the practice.



You will report directly to the practice owner and handle patient communication, scheduling, appointment preparation, insurance verification, records, payments, and administrative follow-up. You will also help document and improve workflows by turning recorded task demonstrations and instructions into clear standard operating procedures.



This position is best suited for someone who has already supported a US medical practice, communicates professionally with patients, and can work accurately and independently without constant supervision.



Strong performance may lead to increased responsibilities, additional hours, and advancement toward a Practice Coordinator role.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Patient Communication and Scheduling



• Answer incoming patient calls during scheduled coverage hours using the practice’s secure phone system.



• Respond to administrative messages, voi
s, and faxes through Spruce, our HIPAA-compliant communication platform.



• Communicate professionally with adult patients and with parents or guardians of minor patients.



• Schedule, reschedule, confirm, and cancel appointments in Osmind, our electronic health record system.



• Maintain an accurate provider calendar and help fill openings created by cancellations.



• Provide patients with administrative information regarding appointments, forms, office procedures, and practice policies.



• Screen, document, and route messages according to written protocols.



• Promptly escalate messages involving safety concerns, medication questions, worsening symptoms, possible adverse effects, or requests for clinical guidance.



This is an administrative position. The assistant will not provide medical advice, interpret symptoms, recommend treatment, or independently make clinical decisions.



Appointment and Visit Preparation



• Review upcoming appointments for completed intake forms, identification, insurance information, payment information, screening questionnaires, and other required documentation.



• Complete pre-visit administrative check-in procedures.



• Confirm telehealth instructions and appointment details.



• Review copays and outstanding balances before appointments.



• Complete the administrative portions of the Spravato pre-treatment checklist.



• Review overnight messages and same-day cancellations at the beginning of each shift.



• Prepare the next business day’s preliminary schedule before the end of each shift.



• Update the current day’s schedule before the provider’s first appointment.



• Notify the provider of missing documentation, scheduling conflicts, urgent administrative issues, or patient concerns requiring review.



Insurance and Billing Support



• Verify insurance eligibility and benefits for Blue Cross Blue Shield of Illinois, Cigna/Evernorth, Aetna, and other assigned payers.



• Document deductibles, copays, coinsurance, behavioral-health benefits, and authorization requirements accurately.



• Submit and track administrative components of prior-authorization requests, including Spravato authorizations.



• Contact payer portals, insurance companies, pharmacies, and medical offices to obtain claim or authorization status information.



• Follow up on unpaid or denied claims, identify payer requests or denial reasons, and document all actions taken.



• Escalate coding questions, clinical documentation requests, appeals, refunds, adjustments, and other matters requiring provider or billing-specialist review.



• Maintain accurate insurance, authorization, and claim-follow-up trackers.



• Process patient-authorized card-on-file payments according to written practice policy.



• Issue receipts and document payments accurately.



The assistant may not independently change fees, waive balances, establish payment arrangements, issue refunds, modify claim coding, adjust account balances, or make collection exceptions without approval from the practice owner.



Records and Practice Administration



• Process medical-record requests, referrals, releases of information, and incoming and outgoing faxes.



• Confirm that appropriate authorization is present before releasing protected health information.



• Keep patient contact, demographic, pharmacy, insurance, and guarantor information current in the EHR.



• Upload, label, route, and organize documents accurately.



• Maintain administrative trackers for referrals, records requests, authorizations, forms, and assigned follow-up tasks.



• Draft standard operating procedures from recorded task walkthroughs and written instructions.



• Revise procedures based on feedback from the practice owner.



• Assist with administrative audits, data-quality reviews, and workflow testing.



• Support a possible future EHR migration from Osmind to CharmHealth.



FIRST 90 DAYS



During the first 90 days, the primary focus will be:



• Patient communication



• Scheduling and cancellation management



• Appointment readiness



• Intake-document tracking



• Insurance verification



• Records and fax processing



• Payment collection



• Documentation of core workflows



More complex responsibilities, including prior authorizations, denied-claim follow-up, reconciliation support, testing logistics, and special projects, will be added as proficiency is demonstrated.



As the role develops, additional responsibilities may include:



• Patient recall and follow-up outreach



• GeneSight and CNS Vital Signs testing logistics



• Spravato administrative coordination



• Credentialing and license-renewal tracking



• Payment-reconciliation support



• Website and provider-directory updates



• EHR migration support



• Additional practice-operations projects



SCHEDULE



Monday through Friday

7:00 AM–1:00 PM US Central Time



This is generally:



• 8:00 PM–2:00 AM Philippine Time during US daylight-saving time



• 9:00 PM–3:00 AM Philippine Time during US standard time



Applicants must be able to work the complete scheduled shift consistently.



Thirty hours per week are guaranteed. The assistant is expected to remain available and actively work throughout all scheduled coverage hours.



When patient volume is lower, scheduled time will be used for records processing, insurance follow-up, SOP development, audits, outreach, and other assigned administrative projects.



Up to 10 additional hours per week may be approved depending on workload. Additional hours may include flexible or asynchronous project work and must be authorized in advance.



Additional regular hours may become available as the practice grows.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• At least two years of experience supporting a US medical practice, healthcare organization, medical office, or US healthcare BPO account.



• Practical knowledge of US healthcare administration, health insurance, and HIPAA requirements.



• Hands-on experience using at least one US electronic health record system, such as Osmind, CharmHealth, Tebra/Kareo, AdvancedMD, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, or SimplePractice.



• Direct experience completing US insurance eligibility and benefit verification and/or prior authorizations.



• Experience communicating with US patients, insurance representatives, pharmacies, and medical offices.



• Excellent written and spoken English.



• Calm, courteous, and professional phone communication.



• Strong judgment regarding when an issue must be escalated.



• Exceptional attention to detail.



• Ability to follow written procedures consistently.



• Ability to work independently and manage recurring responsibilities without frequent reminders.



• Reliable availability for the stated schedule.



• Willingness to complete HIPAA, privacy, cybersecurity, and practice-specific training before receiving access to patient information.



• Willingness to sign all required confidentiality, privacy, security, and service agreements.



• Individual applicants only. Agencies, teams, subcontractors, and applicants planning to delegate the work will not be considered.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Osmind or CharmHealth experience



• Behavioral-health or psychiatric-practice experience



• Spravato or specialty-medication prior-authorization experience



• Experience with Availity or other payer portals and clearinghouses



• Experience following up on denied or unpaid medical claims



• Medical billing or coding education or certification



• Experience as the primary or sole administrative staff member of a small medical practice



• Experience creating standard operating procedures



• Experience supporting an EHR migration



• Familiarity with Spruce, Stripe, Jotform, Google Workspace, GeneSight, or CNS Vital Signs



• Nursing, pharmacy, medical-assisting, or allied-health education



WORKSTATION AND INFORMATION-SECURITY REQUIREMENTS



The selected applicant must have:



• A dedicated personal computer that is not shared with other users.



• A current and supported operating system with current antivirus and security protections.



• Full-disk encryption, automatic updates, and automatic screen locking.



• A separate password-protected computer profile used only for practice work.



• Primary internet service with a minimum speed of 25 Mbps.



• A reliable backup internet connection.



• A backup power source sufficient for short power interruptions.



• A private, quiet workspace where patient information cannot be seen or overheard.



• A professional-quality headset.



• The ability to use multi-factor authentication and a practice-approved password manager.



Protected health information may be accessed only through practice-approved systems.



Patient information may not be downloaded, copied, printed, photographed, screen-recorded, stored locally, or transmitted through personal
, personal cloud storage, consumer messaging applications, or any unapproved system.



Screenshots containing patient information are prohibited. Any suspected privacy or security i
 must be reported immediately.



Screenshot-based time-monitoring software will not be used while the assistant is accessing patient or practice information.



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS



• $7.00–$9.00 USD per hour, based on directly relevant experience and demonstrated skill.



• Guaranteed minimum of 30 paid hours per week.



• Approximate guaranteed monthly base compensation of $910–$1,170 USD.



• Up to 10 additional approved hours per week based on workload.



• Payment twice monthly through Wise or another mutually approved method.



• Prorated 13th-month bonus during the first year.



• Annual performance-based increases generally ranging from $0.50–$1.00 USD per hour.



• Paid major US holidays after 90 days:



New Year’s Day

Memorial Day

Independence Day

Labor Day

Thanksgiving Day

Christmas Day



• Up to 30 hours of paid personal or sick leave annually after 90 days, subject to the written attendance and leave policy.



• Paid required training.



• Paid trial task for selected finalists.



• Opportunity for expanded responsibilities, additional hours, and advancement toward a Practice Coordinator role.



The first 90 days will be a mutual introductory and training period. Final terms will be documented in a written agreement.



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete:



• A 1–2 minute voice recording



• A short written patient-communication scenario



• A typing and data-entry assessment



• A brief paid simulation using fictional or fully de-identified information



• A video interview



• Professional reference verification



• Identity verification



• A background check appropriate for a role involving protected health information, financial transactions, and access to medical-practice systems



No applicant will receive access to live patient information or practice systems before identity verification, required agreements, and privacy and security training are completed.



HOW TO APPLY



Please follow these instructions exactly. Generic or incomplete applications will not be considered.



1. Write the word LIGHTHOUSE on the first line of your application.

2. Attach your current resume or CV.

3. Answer each question below in a separate numbered section:



A. Which US electronic health record systems have you personally used, and approximately how long did you use each one?



B. Describe your experience verifying US insurance eligibility and benefits. Which payers, portals, or clearinghouses have you used?



C. Describe your prior-authorization experience, including any specialty-medication, behavioral-health, or Spravato-related experience.



D. What types of US medical practices have you supported, and what were your primary responsibilities?



E. Without including patient-identifying information, describe one insurance verification, prior-authorization, or denied-claim issue you personally handled. Explain the problem, the steps you took, and the outcome.



F. Describe one workflow, checklist, tracker, or standard operating procedure that you created or improved.



G. State your expected hourly rate.



H. Confirm that you can consistently work Monday through Friday from 7:00 AM–1:00 PM US Central Time.



I. Confirm that you meet the computer, internet, backup-power, privacy, and security requirements listed in this posting.



J. Confirm that you are applying as an individual and will personally perform all assigned work.



All complete applications will be reviewed. Only applicants selected for the next stage will be contacted.

title: Finance Process & Controls Analyst
description:
The Finance Process & Controls Analyst is responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and completeness of financial transactions across the Company's business systems. This role serves as the "exception detective" for Finance, proactively identifying failed transactions, process breakdowns, integration issues, and billing discrepancies before they impact customers, vendors, financial reporting, or cash flow.



The candidate possesses exceptional analytical skills, relentless attention to detail, and a passion for investigating complex problems. Rather than simply processing transactions, this individual will continuously improve business processes, identify automation opportunities, and partner with Finance, Operations, IT, and ERP teams to build scalable, highly reliable financial processes.



FLUENT ENGLISH - READING, SPEAKING, COMPREHENSION required

OBSESSIVE ATTENTION TO DETAIL





Key Responsibilities

Transaction Monitoring & Exception Management

Monitor daily financial transactions across NetSuite and integrated business systems.

Identify invoices, purchase orders, receipts, customer orders, vendor bills, inventory transactions, and journal entries that failed to process correctly.

Investigate exceptions to determine root cause.

Resolve discrepancies or coordinate resolution with the appropriate business teams.

Ensure all identified exceptions are tracked through completion.

Revenue & Billing Assurance

Verify pricing, taxes, freight, discounts, quantities, customer-specific billing rules, and contract terms.

Identify missing or duplicate invoices.

Monitor order-to-cash workflow for failed or incomplete transactions.

Perform reconciliations between operational systems and NetSuite.

Procure-to-Pay Controls

Review vendor invoices for accuracy and completeness.

Investigate purchase order mismatches.

Monitor receiving, vendor bill matching, and approval workflows.

Identify duplicate payments or processing errors.

Validate tax treatment and coding.





Required

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or related field.

5-10 years of experience in accounting, finance operations, ERP systems, business process improvement, or financial systems.

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Exceptional organizational and documentation skills.

Outstanding attention to detail.

NetSuite experience.

SQL knowledge.

title: Xero Bookkeeper / Virtual Assistant (Full Time)
description:
Company: Kingfisher Ads, a US-based advertising agency specializing in Google and Meta ads for the golf industry



About us



We run paid advertising for golf brands, courses, and clubs across the US. Small team, direct communication, no corporate fluff. We move fast and we automate anything worth automating.



The core role



Your foundation is bookkeeping and financial admin:



- Monthly bookkeeping and bank reconciliations in Xero

- Sending a small number of invoices manually each month and managing client billing prep, including pulling ad spend figures from Google and Meta to calculate fees

- Completing our monthly cash flow tracking spreadsheet, which tracks all income and expenses by category

- Helping move clients onto automated payments (ACH)

- Producing a short monthly financial summary: revenue by client, spending trends, anything we should look at

- Making recommendations. If you see a better way to categorize, track, or manage our finances, we want to hear it



You should have real experience doing bookkeeping for US-based businesses. You don't need tax expertise, our CPA handles that, but you should be comfortable with US bookkeeping conventions.



Where the role grows



This is not just a bookkeeping job. As you settle in, you'll take on more of our operations:



- Building and running client onboarding checklists in ClickUp

- Screening job applicants against our criteria before they reach us

- Maintaining our content creator database: logging applicants, updating rates, tracking availability

- Prospect list building and CRM upkeep for our outreach efforts

- Tracking our software subscriptions and flagging waste

- Contractor payment admin as our freelance team grows



The automation angle



We use AI tools and automation heavily and we're building more. Repetitive tasks in this role will get automated over time, with your help. Your job evolves as that happens: you maintain the automations, handle the exceptions, and pick up the next manual thing. If you'd rather do the same task the same way forever, this isn't the right fit. If you're the person who asks "why are we still doing this by hand?" you'll do well here.



Requirements



- 2+ years of bookkeeping experience with Xero

- Experience working with US-based businesses

- Strong written English

- Detail-obsessed. Reconciliations that are almost right are wrong

- Comfortable learning new tools quickly

- Own computer, stable internet, and a backup plan for power or internet outages

- Available for a few hours of overlap with US Eastern time (most of the work is flexible)



Nice to have



- ClickUp experience

- Experience with Zapier, Make, or similar automation tools

- Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) in your daily work

- Agency or marketing industry exposure



Pay



Includes 13th month pay. Full time, long-term role. Salary as listed, paid monthly.



Hiring process



Shortlisted candidates will do a short video interview followed by a paid test task. We respect your time and won't ask for free work.



How to apply



Start your application with the word KINGFISHER so we know you read this post.



Then answer these two questions. Applications without answers to both will not be considered:



1. Describe a repetitive task you automated in a previous role. What tool did you use and what was the result?

2. What's a common mistake you see in how small businesses track cash flow?



Include your Xero experience and the types of US businesses you've done bookkeeping for.

title: Founding SEO Strategist
description:
# Founding SEO Strategist



**Remote · Full-time · $2,000 to $3,000/mo to start, with a clear path up**



---



## Read this part first



Most SEO job posts are written by people who can't tell a good SEO from a bad one. This one isn't. I run the campaigns myself, I've built the systems, and I know exactly what "good" looks like, so I'm going to be direct about who I want.



I want someone cracked. Someone who ranks sites in their sleep, treats a stalled campaign as a puzzle instead of a reason to
 me asking what to do, and has real opinions about SEO earned from testing things, not from watching YouTube.



If that's you, keep reading. If it's not, no hard feelings.



## Who we are



We're an established SEO agency helping local businesses, mostly home-service contractors (roofing, HVAC, cleaning, window cleaning), and a handful of e-commerce brands rank at the top of Google. US-based, US clients. We already have the structure: documented SOPs, proven processes, and results that keep clients coming back. We're growing fast, and now we want to go from strong to exceptional. That's where you come in.



## The role



This is our **founding SEO strategist** seat. You're the first dedicated SEO hire stepping into a machine that already works, not a mess you have to clean up. The systems are built and they produce. Your job is to take them further: run them at a high level, own delivery for our clients, and make the systems themselves genuinely stronger so our results go from great to exceptional.



You'll build advanced strategy alongside me. I want someone who knows the real levers and the order to pull them in, not someone who runs a 40-point checklist because a course told them to. I know that the primary category move is worth more than the next hundred citations. I know review velocity beats review count. I know most of what agencies sell is hygiene dressed up as growth. You should know that too, in your bones, from having tested it.



A big part of this is AI, and I mean both sides of it: automating our own grunt work so we deliver faster, and owning the shift to AI search before our clients even know it's happening. This is a long-term seat. I want someone I can grow with for years.



## What you'll own



- Owning SEO delivery across our client campaigns, start to finish

- Google Business Profile as the primary battleground: category strategy, proximity and service-area logic, and the engagement signals that actually hold a map-pack position once you win it

- Verifying and defending profiles across multiple clients: passing video verification, working suspensions back to live with proper documentation, and knowing the DBA/business-registry angle when a straight appeal stalls

- Review systems that run themselves: building velocity without tripping Google's filter, and recovering legitimate reviews that got filtered or wrongly removed instead of shrugging and chasing new ones

- Taking our existing SOPs and making the
asurably stronger, then documenting what you changed and why

- Automating the boring parts with AI (Claude, APIs, whatever gets it done) so neither of us does the same manual task twice

- On-page and technical: canonicalization, schema, internal link equity flow, site structure that a page-2 result can climb out of

- Link building with judgment. Manufacturer and certification directories, real editorial placements, natural anchor profiles. You know why a pile of high-DR links with no topical relevance does nothing, and you know what an over-optimized anchor profile looks like before Google does

- Citation building and ordering as a hygiene floor, not a monthly deliverable we pretend is moving the needle

- Getting new pages and links **indexed** (we run paid indexers, not GSC "please crawl this" prayers), and knowing not to submit a URL before the destination content is actually live

- Keyword and competitor research that produces a decision, not a spreadsheet nobody opens

- GEO / AI search: llms.txt, FAQ and question-based structure, entity and schema work, and tracking where our clients surface across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Grok. Roughly a third of LLM-cited pages have zero organic presence, and I want someone who already understands why that's an opportunity

- Blog strategy and content scheduling that feeds both classic ranking and AI citation

- Analytics and reporting (GA4, GSC, GTM, plus AI-referral tracking) turned into the next three moves, not a chart that goes up



## Who you are



- **Native-level English.** You'll talk to me constantly and sometimes to clients. Non-negotiable.

- **An over-communicator.** This is the one I care about most. I want too many updates, not too few. If you go quiet, this doesn't work. The best people on my team tell me what's happening before I have to ask.

- **A problem-solver with no ego.** A stalled campaign is a puzzle, not a reason to
 me asking what to do. You hit a wall, you research it, you test your way out, then you tell me what you learned. I leave my ego at the door and I want the same from you.

- **Fluent across the whole spectrum.** White hat, grey hat, and enough understanding of black hat to know exactly where the line is and why we don't drag client assets across it. I don't want a cowboy who torches a client's profile chasing a shortcut. I want someone who knows PBNs, parasite SEO, expired-domain plays, CTR and engagement manipulation, and DBA/name strategy well enough to recognize them in a competitor's profile and d
, deliberately, what's worth it and what isn't.

- **Always sharpening.** The day you think you know everything about SEO is the day you stopped testing.



## What you've actually done



- **Ranked multiple local businesses** into the map pack and held them there. Not "worked on." Ranked. You can walk me through a campaign where you knew the lever, pulled it, and watched the position move. Local is our bread and butter; e-commerce is a strong bonus.

- **Tested your own strategies on your own properties.** White hat, grey hat, whatever taught you something. I want someone who's broken a site, understood why, and rebuilt it smarter. Cookie-cutter operators need not apply.

- **AI-fluent and automation-first.** You automate instead of grinding. Comfortable with Claude, wiring up APIs, and spinning up full site builds fast. If a process can run itself, you build it once instead of doing it by hand forever.

- **Verified and reinstated GBPs the hard way.** You've passed video verification, you've fought a suspended profile back to live with real documentation, and you've won back reviews that got filtered or removed. Anyone can swap a category. Recovering a suspended profile is where I find out whether you actually know the platform.

- **Understand what actually holds a ranking:** engagement signals, dwell time, click behavior, the conversion actions Google reads through Chrome. You know that winning position one and keeping it are two different games.

- **Expert in the core tools:** Semrush, Ahrefs, GSC, GA4, GTM. Bonus if you've lived in BrightLocal, indexers, and any of the AI-visibility trackers and claude code.

- **Worked on a team before.** You know how to hand off, document, and collaborate.



*(Quick one so I know you actually read this: what's your favorite vegetable, and why? Put the answer at the very top of your application.)*



## What I offer



- **Growth that's real.** As we add clients, the role grows and your pay grows with it. $2,000/mo to start, scaling toward $3,000+ as you take on more ownership, and higher over time as we grow together.

- **A real path to managing.** You're the founding SEO hire. As the team grows, the right person becomes the one who runs it.

- **Real ownership.** No bureaucracy, no ten layers of approval. You own SEO here and you'll feel it.



## Logistics



- **Full-time, remote.**

- **Overlap with US business hours.** I need at least [X] hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time so we can collaborate in real time. Tell me your timezone and normal working hours.

- Start date: ASAP



## How to apply



Send me the following, and yes, I read every single one:



1. Your favorite vegetable and why (from above)

2. Your name and age

3. **What motivates you, be brutally honest.** "Money" is a fine answer if it's the true one. I trust honest people more than polished ones.

4. The coolest thing you've ever done with SEO



Apply here:

title: PostAI Account Manager (Customer Success + AI Video, English)
description:
PostAI Account Manager — Done-for-You AI Video + Customer Success

Full-time | Remote (work from home) | GMT+8 friendly

Pay: 25% commission per video (~S$10–20 each, uncapped), with a guaranteed minimum of S$400/month.



ABOUT POSTAI

PostAI is an AI platform that lets anyone create professional marketing videos in minutes. The problem: many of our users WANT great videos but don't have the time to make them. That's where you come in.



As a PostAI Account Manager, you become a small business owner inside PostAI. We assign you customers; you create their videos by using PostAI platform, so our users are hands free and you grow your own book of clients. The more value you create, the more you earn — your income is uncapped.



WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

The work we pay you for — running demos, helping customers, and recording short demo clips — is ALSO how you grow your own income. Every demo you host and every clip you record can bring you new clients. You simply upload your clips to a shared folder; our system posts and distributes everything automatically and credits the leads to you. You never publish anything yourself. You're not just an employee — you're building a business with PostAI's tools, brand, and customer pipeline behind you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Understand each customer's needs, then make their video. Talk with your assigned customers to capture exactly what they want, then log into their PostAI account (via secure delegated access) and create the video. PostAI is click-based — no prompt-writing or technical skill needed. Most videos take about 20 minutes. Once in a while a small CapCut tweak is needed, to make a professional video

- Customer success and demos. Chat with your customers, answer questions, and run "over-the-shoulder" guidance over screen share. Host Zoom sessions teaching people how to use PostAI — attendees can hire you directly.

- Record demo clips (we auto-post them for you). Record your sessions and turn each into 3–5 short screen-demo videos (about 1 minute each; longer for a feature walk-through). Just upload them to a shared folder — our system posts and distributes everything automatically and routes inbound leads back to you.

- Own your customers. Keep them happy, responsive, and coming back. Retained customers mean recurring commission for you.

-You need take role as customer support / customer success manager, answer enquires and run demo/workshop, thats the way you build trust and get more potential clients (who hire you to create their videos)



COMPENSATION

- Commission: 25% of each video's value — roughly S$10–20 per video — with NO cap. Each video is quick (about 20 min), so strong managers earn well above the minimum.

- Guaranteed minimum: S$400/month. How it works: if your total commission for the month is below S$400, we pay you S$400; if it's above S$400, you keep the full amount. You're always paid whichever is higher.

- Example: at just 5 videos/day you're already earning multiples of the minimum; top performers do far more.

- 1-month onboarding period, then ongoing full-time.



WHAT WE EXPECT (minimum monthly)

- Full-time availability (about 40 hrs/week) and replies to your customers within 0.5 business hours.

- At least 20 delivered videos/month (scaled to the number of customers assigned to you — if we send you fewer, the target adjusts).

- From your sessions, produce 3–5 short screen-demo clips (about 1 min each) and upload them to the shared folder. Posting is automatic.

- Maintain quality and customer satisfaction (low redo rate, happy customers).



YOU MUST HAVE

- Excellent spoken and written English — this is the #1 skill. You'll be on demos and chatting with customers every day.

- Strong CapCut skills — you'll cut your session recordings into short demo clips, and make minor tweaks to customer videos.

- Comfortable on camera (Zoom demos and clips).

- A genuine customer-first attitude: patient, clear, friendly, reliable.

- Quick to learn software. PostAI itself is easy and click-based — no prompt-writing needed; we'll train you.

- A reliable computer and stable internet, available full-time.



NICE TO HAVE

- Familiar with AI tools — especially AI image generation and AI video generation. A big plus.

- Experience in customer support, virtual assistance, or SaaS.

- Experience making short-form content (TikTok / Reels / Shorts).

About BIWE



BIWE is a global personal and professional development platform connecting ambitious individuals through media, technology, events, and community. Our ecosystem includes:



Inspiration & Success Magazine (quarterly print + digital, ~5,000 readers across Lagos, Houston, London, Manila, and Nairobi — coaches, HR leaders, and managers)

BIWE App

BIWE Podcast

BIWE Events

Newsletter & Community





We're looking for someone who enjoys building relationships, creating opportunities, and helping a growing brand expand its reach. This is not an administrative or coordinator role. Your primary focus is business growth — advertising sales, partnerships, and magazine distribution — with light reporting to keep everything organized.



What You'll Do



Advertising & Sponsorship Sales (Primary Focus — this is how you earn commission)





Prospect and contact potential advertisers daily via
, LinkedIn, and phone — target industries include financial institutions, coaching companies, universities, HR tech, wellness brands, professional services, real estate, and corporate organizations.

Present BIWE advertising opportunities and sponsorship packages (print, digital, App, newsletter, event sponsorships).

Follow up consistently to move opportunities through the pipeline.

Secure advertising commitments and coordinate deposit collection ahead of print deadlines.

Introduce cross-platform upsells (e.g., adding a BIWE App banner alongside a print ad).





Partnerships & Business Development





Identify and pursue partnership opportunities that expand BIWE's visibility (e.g., content/promotion swaps with aligned newsletters or brands).

Build relationships with organizations, associations, and brands.

Source potential contributors and collaborators for the magazine, app, podcast, and events.





Magazine Distribution





Secure premium distribution locations — airports, hotels, spas, coworking spaces, universities, executive lounges, bookstores, wellness centers.

Build and maintain a distribution database, and coordinate placement confirmations where applicable.

Use distribution wins as leverage in advertising conversations ("We're placed at Soho House — your ad belongs there too").



Reporting & Organization

Maintain an accurate CRM/Google Sheet: company, contact, status, value, deadline.

Send a short weekly progress update (outreach, deals in motion, distribution wins, next steps).

Keep follow-ups organized so no opportunity gets lost. This is an expectation of the role — not a condition of commission, which is earned on closed and paid advertising regardless of reporting status.





What We're Looking For





You've personally closed deals before. When you apply, tell us: who you sold to, what you sold, and roughly how much. "I assisted with sales" doesn't answer this — we want to hear about deals you drove yourself.

Comfortable and confident
ing or calling a CEO or business owner directly — no generic scripts.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Proactive and resourceful — you treat "no" as information, not rejection, and know that consistent volume (calls,
s, follow-ups) is what produces yeses.

Deadline-driven — when a print or campaign deadline is approaching, you follow up as many times as it takes.

Comfortable working independently and communicating async — replies to a WhatsApp or
 update within a reasonable window during your working hours.

Familiar with LinkedIn,
 outreach, Google Workspace, and CRM tools. Experience with Apollo or similar prospecting tools is a plus.

Success in This Role





Advertising revenue closed (this is the core metric — and how your commission is earned).

Qualified advertising opportunities generated and moved through the pipeline.

New partnership opportunities secured.

Premium distribution locations added.

Accurate, consistently updated CRM with no dropped follow-ups.

Commission: 15% of closed and collected advertising revenue, paid [on deposit / on full payment — confirm which].

This is a [contractor / part-time employee] position.

Realistic first-90-day expectations will be discussed and set together during onboarding, based on current pipeline and lead sources available to you.





Why Join BIWE?



You'll be joining an ambitious, growing international brand with room to make a direct, visible impact. As BIWE expands across media, technology, and events, this role offers a genuine path to take on more ownership and responsibility as revenue grows.

title: Healthcare Insurance Verifications Specialist
description:
PLEASE INCLUDE A LINK TO YOUR RESUME IN YOUR MESSAGE. APPLICANTS WHO DO NOT INCLUDE A LINK IN YOUR MESSAGE WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Position Overview:

An Insurance Verifications Specialist is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and completeness of healthcare insurance information for patients or clients. This role involves verifying insurance coverage, confirming if prior authorizations are needed or not, and working closely with insurance companies.



Pocket Overview:

Pocket provides a cheaper and faster insurance verification process for physical therapists.

We know that insurance verification is painful and can take up to 1-2 hours to verify a patient's insurance coverage, potentially delaying appointment scheduling and care.

Pocket will take on the pain of dealing with insurance so front desk staff can focus on customer-facing interactions and PTs can focus on what they do best – treating patients.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Healthcare Insurance Verification:

Confirm patient eligibility and insurance coverage by contacting insurance carriers via phone.

Responsible for effective and efficient verification of all patients’ benefits before their appointment.

Verify benefits for physical therapy services.

Ensure accurate documentation of coverage details, including co-pays, deductibles, out-of-pocket expenses, authorization requirements and visit limits.

2. Authorizations:

Confirm if authorization is needed or not

If it’s needed, confirm what is required to submit authorization

3. Data Entry and Record Maintenance:

Accurately input insurance details into our internal database or client’s EMR platform.

Update patient accounts with the latest insurance information and maintain confidentiality in compliance with HIPAA regulations.

Record calls using online recording software (provided by Pocket)

4. Customer and Team Support:

Serve as a point of contact for physical therapy admin staff with questions about their insurance coverage or billing.

5. Problem-Solving:
